13300.name: The Second Level Of Durgan's Chimney

north.description: To the north lies The Whispering Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Courtyard.

west.description: To the west lies A Windswept Hallway.

up.description: To the up lies The First Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

down.description: To the down lies The Third Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

13300.description:
A great natural flue of grey rock drops through the deeps here, and this
landing is a broad ledge hacked around its wall. A cold draught sinks
from the shaft above, where a rough way up stands open toward the dwarf
mines, while warm foul air breathes up from the way down. Torches gutter
in iron sconces beside a heavy door in the east wall. Passages lead away
north into a whispering hallway and west along a windswept one.

13301.name: A Windswept Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Second Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

west.description: To the west lies The Lore-Hall.

13301.description:
A cold wind moans along this hallway, tugging the soot from the torch-
brackets and sending grit skittering over the floor. The walls are cut
grey stone with long cracks like old scars. Far down the passage a door
of black oak stands closed against the draught. The landing of the
chimney lies east, and the door leads on west toward the Lore-Hall.

13302.name: The Lore-Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Crypt Of Alvis.

east.description: To the east lies A Windswept Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies A Wide Tunnel.

13302.description:
Shelves hewn into the rock line this hall, stacked with cracked slates,
mouldering scrolls and heaps of knucklebones scratched with tally-runes.
A reading stand of black iron stands in the centre, its lectern split in
two. The air is dry as dust and smells faintly of old incense. A low
archway leads north toward a crypt, the hallway lies east, and a wide
tunnel opens south.

13303.name: The Crypt Of Alvis

south.description: To the south lies The Lore-Hall.

13303.description:
Stone coffins stand in a ring around this low burial chamber, their lids
carved with the faces of long-dead scholars. Burial niches fill the
walls from floor to vault, most of them empty, their contents scattered
on the ground. A film of grey dust lies over everything and the air is
bitterly cold. The only way back is south to the Lore-Hall.

13304.name: A Wide Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Lore-Hall.

east.description: To the east lies A Wide Tunnel.

13304.description:
The tunnel here is wide enough for six to walk abreast, its walls shored
with timbers gone black and soft. Deep ruts in the floor show where
heavy carts once ground back and forth. A trickle of water runs down the
rock in a glittering ribbon. The Lore-Hall is just north, and the tunnel
continues east.

13305.name: A Wide Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Wide Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Wide Tunnel.

13305.description:
The tunnel turns here, and the shoring on the outer curve has slumped,
spilling a fan of gravel across the floor. Pick-marks score the rock in
long parallel strokes. A cold breath of air comes from the way south,
smelling of ice and metal. The wide tunnel runs back west and on south.

13306.name: A Wide Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Wide Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Three-Way Junction In A Wide Tunnel.

13306.description:
A cart-rail of rotted wood runs down the middle of the floor and ends in
a splintered stump. Lamp-smoke has stained the roof the colour of old
tar, and a single hobnail print is baked into the dried mud. The tunnel
goes north, and a short way on east toward a junction.

13307.name: A Three-Way Junction In A Wide Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Thund's Eye.

south.description: To the south lies A Wide Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Wide Tunnel.

13307.description:
Three tunnels meet in a ragged chamber whose roof is propped by a stout
central timber carved with notches. Cold draughts argue with warm ones,
and the torch-smoke swirls in slow eddies. A faded arrow is daubed in
red on the rock. Wide tunnels lead south and west, while to the east a
round cavern gleams with a strange white light.

13308.name: Thund's Eye

north.description: To the north lies A Wide Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Three-Way Junction In A Wide Tunnel.

13308.description:
A domed cavern whose roof holds a single great disc of pale crystal,
glowing like a blind white eye over the floor. Its cold light picks out
veins of quartz and a ring of fallen pillars around a dry basin. The air
hums faintly and your hair prickles. A tunnel leads north, and the way
west returns to the junction.

extra_descs.crystal eye disc:
The crystal is as wide as a cartwheel and perfectly round, set into the
roof as though it had been placed there. Its glow brightens and dims in
a slow rhythm, like a great eye blinking.

13309.name: A Wide Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Three-Way Junction In A Wide Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Guardhouse.

13309.description:
A broad tunnel, wide enough for a wagon team, its floor rutted by wheel
tracks. A stout door set in the south wall leads into a guardhouse, and
a barred lantern hangs beside it. North the tunnel runs to a three-way
junction. The roof is pocked with the soot of many torches.

13310.name: Guardhouse

north.description: To the north lies A Wide Tunnel.

13310.description:
A small stone guardhouse with arrow slits in the walls and a brazier
smouldering in the middle of the floor. Bunks of rough planks are
stacked against one wall, and a table is scattered with dice and greasy
cards. A rack of notched spears stands by the door. The only way out is
north, through the door to the wide tunnel.

13311.name: A Wide Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Cold Mines.

south.description: To the south lies Thund's Eye.

13311.description:
The tunnel runs on from the glowing cavern, and frost begins to rime the
lower rock. The timber props wear coats of white crystals, and your
breath smokes. Pick-marks on the walls grow sparse and then vanish. The
way leads south to the cavern of the crystal eye and east to the mouth
of the cold mines.

13312.name: Entrance To The Cold Mines

west.description: To the west lies A Wide Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies The Frozen Steps.

13312.description:
A broad mouth of hewn rock opens into the cold mines, its lintel thick
with icicles and its floor polished by feet and frozen runoff. A wooden
sign, cracked and iced over, has lost all its lettering. A stair of
frozen steps winds down into blue darkness, and a bitter wind climbs
from it. The tunnel lies behind you to the west.

13313.name: The Whispering Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Whispering Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Second Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

13313.description:
A narrow hallway of cut grey stone begins here, and every footfall comes
back to you as a murmur from the walls. The south end opens onto the
landing of the chimney, its torchlight fading behind you. Soot streaks
the ceiling above a row of rusted brackets that once held lamps. The
passage bends and runs on east into more of the same low whispering.

13314.name: The Whispering Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Whispering Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Whispering Hallway.

13314.description:
The whispering hallway runs straight here, its floor worn into two
shallow troughs by generations of heavy boots. Faint voices seem to
slide along the stone, never quite forming a word. A deep gouge in the
wall marks where some heavy cart scraped past. Ahead the hallway goes on
east, and behind you it runs west.

13315.name: The Whispering Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Whispering Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Whispering Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Whispering Hallway.

13315.description:
Three ways meet in this stretch of the whispering hallway, and the
murmuring thickens where the draughts cross. Scratched into the plaster
are crude tally marks, hundreds of them, in uneven rows. The hallway
carries on west toward the chimney, east along its main run, and north
into a darker, narrower arm.

13316.name: The Whispering Hallway

south.description: To the south lies The Whispering Hallway.

13316.description:
The hallway ends in a blind alcove of damp grey stone, and the whispers
here are almost close enough to understand. A cracked clay jug lies in
the corner beside a heap of rotted sacking. Cold seeps through the wall,
and the air tastes of old smoke. The only way out is back south.

13317.name: The Whispering Hallway

south.description: To the south lies The Whispering Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Whispering Hallway.

13317.description:
A corner of the hallway where the passage turns from west to south, its
inner angle rubbed smooth by passing shoulders. Black stains spread up
the wall from a dead torch-socket, and the whispering comes in slow
waves like breathing. A few rotten planks are stacked against the stone.
The hall goes on south, or back west.

13318.name: The Whispering Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Whispering Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies The Whispering Hallway.

13318.description:
The hallway sags here, and a thin sheet of seeping water gleams across
the flagstones. Green slime clings to the lower courses of the walls,
and the whispers sound wetter, as if spoken through a mouthful of water.
A rusted manacle hangs from a ring bolted high on the stone. The passage
runs north toward a corner and east toward a straighter run.

13319.name: The Whispering Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Whispering Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Whispering Hallway.

13319.description:
Rough-cut pillars of grey stone stand in pairs along this stretch of
hallway, each carved with a snarling face worn nearly smooth. The
whispering is loud among them, a dry sibilant rustle with no source.
Torch-soot has blackened the ceiling into a low dark vault. You can go
north along the hall or west the way you came.

13320.name: The Whispering Hallway

east.description: To the east lies The Whispering Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies The Whispering Hallway.

13320.description:
A hush falls where the hallway doubles back on itself, as though the
walls were listening. A scatter of splintered bone and gnawed gristle
lies in the dust by the wall. Old drum-beats thud faintly through the
stone from somewhere far off. The hall continues east, while the way
south returns to the earlier bends.

13321.name: The Whispering Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Whispering Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies The Whispering Hallway.

13321.description:
The floor here is cracked and heaved, and a tongue of cold air creeps
along it from the north. Faded paint on the walls once showed a
procession of figures, but only their feet and spears remain legible.
The whispers rise and fall in time with the distant drumming. The
hallway goes on north toward a damper smell and west toward the bend.

13322.name: The Whispering Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Shallow Lake.

south.description: To the south lies The Whispering Hallway.

13322.description:
The hallway ends at a rough arch, and beyond it a black sheet of water
fills the passage from wall to wall. The stones underfoot are slick, and
the whispering gives way to the slow lap of ripples. A rotted rope
trails from an iron ring into the shallows. Behind you the hall runs
south, and north the lake begins.

13323.name: The Shallow Lake

east.description: To the east lies The Chamber Of The Axes.

south.description: To the south lies The Whispering Hallway.

down.description: To the down lies Beneath The Shallow Lake.

13323.description:
You drift on a small raft across black, shallow water that smells of
iron and old stone. The roof hangs low overhead, dripping, and ripples
spread from every drop. A broken landing of stone steps leads south to
the hallway, while to the east a low arch opens into a chamber glinting
with metal. Below, the water deepens into a darker well.

13324.name: The Chamber Of The Axes

west.description: To the west lies The Shallow Lake.

13324.description:
Axes of every make hang from the walls of this stone chamber: single-
bladed, double-bladed, notched, chipped and rusted red. Racks of
splintered hafts stand against one side, and a long scarred table is
bolted to the floor. Water from the lake has crept across the threshold
and left a damp line on the flags. The only way out is back west across
the water.

extra_descs.axes wall:
Each axe has a notch or a mark cut into the haft, a tally of some kind.
The oldest are green with age, the newest still keen enough to shave
with.

13325.name: Beneath The Shallow Lake

up.description: To the up lies The Shallow Lake.

13325.description:
Cold dark water closes around you, murky and green, with grit drifting
through it like slow snow. Shapes of fallen stone loom below, and
something pale and rounded lies half buried in silt. The pressure builds
in your ears with every moment. Far above, a faint glimmer marks the way
up to the surface.

13326.name: The Frozen Steps

up.description: To the up lies Entrance To The Cold Mines.

down.description: To the down lies The Frozen Steps.

13326.description:
Steps cut into the living rock descend steeply, each glazed with clear
ice that mirrors your torch. The walls are furred with frost, and
meltwater has frozen in long grey streamers beside the stair. A rusted
rail has been bolted to one side, now fused to the stone. The steps rise
toward the mine entrance and fall away into the cold.

13327.name: The Frozen Steps

up.description: To the up lies The Frozen Steps.

down.description: To the down lies At The Bottom Of The Frozen Steps.

13327.description:
The stair bends slightly here, and the ice thickens until the steps are
no more than ridges beneath a glassy skin. Far below something drips,
and each drop rings like a bell. Thin white crystals bloom across the
rock like frozen moss. You can climb back up or go carefully on down.

13328.name: At The Bottom Of The Frozen Steps

south.description: To the south lies The Cold Tunnels.

up.description: To the up lies The Frozen Steps.

13328.description:
The stair ends in a flat floor of old blue ice, rutted where sledges
have been dragged across it. A cairn of black stones stands against the
wall, rimed in white. The cold is fierce enough to numb the lips. A
tunnel leads south into the frozen deeps, and the steps climb up behind
you.

13329.name: The Cold Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies At The Bottom Of The Frozen Steps.

south.description: To the south lies The Cold Tunnels.

13329.description:
Ice has swallowed this tunnel's walls so that it seems carved from
glass, and the light you carry is thrown back in a hundred pale blurs.
The floor is sanded with grit to give a footing. Breath hangs in the air
like smoke. The tunnel runs north toward the foot of the steps and south
into deeper cold.

13330.name: The Cold Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies The Cold Tunnels.

13330.description:
The tunnel narrows to a crawl-high squeeze, where hoarfrost grows in
feathers on the roof and brushes your shoulders as you pass. Scratches
on the floor show where heavy things have been dragged. The cold is dry
and still, and your footsteps are swallowed. The only way on is east.

13331.name: The Cold Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies The Cold Tunnels.

13331.description:
A long straight run of tunnel, its walls banded in white and grey like
the strata of some frozen sea. Fallen icicles lie in shattered heaps. A
scrap of iron chain, white with frost, runs a few paces along the floor
and vanishes into the wall. The tunnel leads east.

13332.name: The Cold Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Cold Tunnels.

13332.description:
The tunnel bends sharply, and a cold current pours around the corner as
if from a bellows. Rime grows thick on a rusted pickaxe head left
embedded in the rock. The floor tilts a little upward. The passage
climbs north.

13333.name: The Cold Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies At The Top Of The Subterranean Glacier.

13333.description:
Black meltwater trickles across the floor in tiny channels, freezing
into lace at the edges. The air ahead has a faint blue tinge, and a low
groan from far above rolls through the stone, the sound of a vast weight
shifting. Lumps of ice the size of fists litter the passage. The way
leads north onto a great glacier.

13334.name: At The Top Of The Subterranean Glacier

east.description: To the east lies Climbing A Narrow Ramp.

13334.description:
You stand on a wide shelf of blue-white ice at the crest of a buried
glacier, its surface scoured into ridges and hollows. The cavern roof
arches high above, hung with pillars of ice thick as tree-trunks. Cracks
run through the ice with deep, shuddering pops. A narrow ramp climbs
away east, while the low tunnel you came by lies behind.

13335.name: Climbing A Narrow Ramp

west.description: To the west lies At The Top Of The Subterranean Glacier.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing A Narrow Ramp.

13335.description:
A narrow ramp of packed snow and grit winds along the glacier's flank,
barely wide enough for one traveller. Beyond its crumbling edge the ice
drops away into blue shadow. A frayed hemp rope runs along the wall at
waist height as a handrail. The ramp leads west back to the glacier's
crest and down further into the cavern.

13336.name: Climbing A Narrow Ramp

up.description: To the up lies Climbing A Narrow Ramp.

down.description: To the down lies At The Entrance To The Chambers Of Power.

13336.description:
The ramp steepens, and steps have been chopped into the ice to give the
boots a bite. Meltwater glitters in the grooves, and the rope handrail
is stiff as an iron bar. Below, torchlight flickers in an archway of
dark stone. The ramp goes up behind you and down toward that archway.

13337.name: At The Entrance To The Chambers Of Power

east.description: To the east lies The Limestone Tunnels.

up.description: To the up lies Climbing A Narrow Ramp.

13337.description:
The ramp lets out before a great archway of black basalt, its pillars
carved with ranks of squat figures bearing hammers. The air here is
warmer, and a dull red glow pulses faintly from inside, beating like a
slow heart. Soot and ash have dusted the ice at the threshold. Limestone
tunnels lead east, and the ramp climbs back up.

13338.name: The Limestone Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Limestone Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies At The Entrance To The Chambers Of Power.

13338.description:
Pale limestone walls close in here, sweating and slick, their surface
carved by water into smooth scallops. Tiny stalactites drip from the
roof in rows, each holding a bead of light. The warmth of the forges
seeps through the rock. A tunnel leads north, and the archway lies west.

13339.name: The Limestone Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Limestone Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies The Limestone Tunnels.

13339.description:
The limestone has been shaped into an arcade of low pillars here, formed
where dripping water met the floor and rose to meet the roof. Between
them lie pools no wider than a shield, still as polished silver. The
echoes sound twice as long as they should. The tunnel runs north and
south.

13340.name: The Limestone Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Limestone Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies The Limestone Tunnels.

13340.description:
Soot streaks the limestone in black fans above wall-niches where lamps
once stood. The floor is worn into a trough, and a trail of dropped
coal-dust leads along it. The air grows hotter and smells of heated
iron. The way runs north toward the forges and south toward the archway.

13341.name: The Limestone Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Cold Forges.

south.description: To the south lies The Limestone Tunnels.

13341.description:
A ringing reaches you here, faint at first, then steadily louder: the
sound of hammers on anvils far ahead. The walls are warm to the touch
and the limestone shows pink where heat has scorched it. Cinders crunch
underfoot. The forges lie to the north, and the tunnel goes back south.

13342.name: The Cold Forges

north.description: To the north lies The Forge Of Power.

south.description: To the south lies The Limestone Tunnels.

13342.description:
A row of stone forges lines this cavern, their hearths gone cold and
clogged with grey clinker. Hammers lie where they were dropped, and a
bellows hangs slack and cracked from its frame. The roof is blackened
above, and a draught of frozen air drifts across the anvils. The Forge
of Power lies to the north, and the limestone tunnel leads back south.

13343.name: The Forge Of Power

south.description: To the south lies The Cold Forges.

west.description: To the west lies Accesway To The Seventh Deep.

13343.description:
The greatest forge in the deeps squats at the heart of this cavern, a
vast hearth of black stone with an anvil like an altar before it. Embers
still pulse red in the ashes, though no one has fed them in an age. Slag
runs in frozen rivulets across the floor. The cold forges lie south, and
a passage leads west toward a stair down.

extra_descs.anvil altar hearth:
The anvil is scarred by blows from hammers far larger than any smith
could swing. Runes of power circle its base, filled with old black soot.

13344.name: Accesway To The Seventh Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Forge Of Power.

down.description: To the down lies The Narrow Stairs.

13344.description:
A round shaft opens in the floor at the end of this short passage,
rimmed with an iron rail and a narrow stair cut spiralling down. Warm
air rises from it, thick with the smell of wet stone. Tool marks cover
the walls in neat rows, the work of patient hands. The passage returns
east, and the stair leads down.

13345.name: The Narrow Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Accesway To The Seventh Deep.

down.description: To the down lies At The Foot Of The Narrow Stairs.

13345.description:
The stairs are cut so tight that your shoulders brush the rock on both
sides. Each tread is hollowed in the middle, polished by ages of boots.
A slow drip echoes up from below and the air feels heavier with every
step. You can climb back up or keep descending.

13346.name: At The Foot Of The Narrow Stairs

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Black Iron Gate.

up.description: To the up lies The Narrow Stairs.

13346.description:
The stairs end in a small landing where a heavy slab of stone has been
rolled aside from a doorway. Water pools in the corners and the walls
are furred with pale moss. Tunnel mouths gape in two directions: a damp
one leading north, and a short approach south to a black iron gate. The
stairs climb up behind you.

13347.name: The Courtyard

east.description: To the east lies Walking The Streets.

south.description: To the south lies Walking The Streets.

west.description: To the west lies The Second Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

13347.description:
A cobbled courtyard opens in the cavern floor, rimmed by rough stone
houses whose doors are hung with skulls and bundles of feathers. A
greasy smoke of cookfires hangs against the high roof, and drums beat
steadily somewhere deeper in. Rubbish and bones are heaped in the
gutters. A heavy door at the west side leads back to the chimney, while
streets lead away east and south.

13348.name: Walking The Streets

north.description: To the north lies Walking The Streets.

east.description: To the east lies Walking The Streets.

south.description: To the south lies Walking The Streets.

west.description: To the west lies The Courtyard.

13348.description:
Narrow streets of mortared fieldstone cross here beneath the cavern
roof, lit by oily torches in wall-brackets. Crude banners of black hide
hang from the lintels, each daubed with a red fist. The ground is rutted
by heavy carts and ankle-deep in filth near the gutters. Lanes go north
and south, a wider street runs east, and the courtyard lies back west.

13349.name: Walking The Streets

north.description: To the north lies A Small Stone Building.

east.description: To the east lies Walking The Streets.

south.description: To the south lies Walking The Streets.

13349.description:
The street bends past a squat house of piled grey stone, its door
hanging open on leather hinges. Smoke drifts from a hole in the roof,
carrying a stink of boiled fat. A wooden rack of curing hides leans
against the wall, and tallow candles gutter in niches. The street runs
east and south, and the doorway to the north leads into the squat house.

13350.name: A Small Stone Building

south.description: To the south lies Walking The Streets.

13350.description:
One low room of roughly mortared stone holds a straw pallet, a clay
hearth gone cold, and a heap of stripped bones. The roof is just high
enough to stand under, blackened with years of smoke. A cracked bowl and
a bent spoon lie on a stool beside a crooked shelf. The street lies just
outside, back to the south.

13351.name: Walking The Streets

east.description: To the east lies A Small Stone Building.

south.description: To the south lies Walking The Streets.

west.description: To the west lies Walking The Streets.

13351.description:
The street passes a trodden yard where the dirt is packed hard and
scorched in a ring from some old fire. A shed leans against the nearest
house, its roof patched with scraps of iron. Crow claws and strings of
dried gut hang as charms from every doorpost. A door to the east opens
on a small stone house, the street goes south, and the lane west leads
back toward the corner.

13352.name: A Small Stone Building

west.description: To the west lies Walking The Streets.

13352.description:
This small stone house is cramped and reeks of sour ale; a barrel stands
on its end beside a table made from an old cart bed. Notches are cut in
the lintel in groups of five, and a rusted chain hangs from the ceiling
beam. The floor is trampled earth, black with spilled drink. Only one
way leads out, west to the street.

13353.name: Walking The Streets

north.description: To the north lies Walking The Streets.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Stone Building.

west.description: To the west lies Walking The Streets.

13353.description:
A crooked square forms where the street widens, and a stone trough in
its middle stands cracked and dry. Soot-black walls rise on every side,
scored with claw marks and daubed with red hand-prints. The drums beat
louder here, and the ground trembles faintly with them. Streets run
north and west, and a door to the east leads into a small stone house.

13354.name: A Small Stone Building

west.description: To the west lies Walking The Streets.

13354.description:
The single room of this small stone house is crowded with crates of
looted goods, broken lanterns and sacks of bitter-smelling grain. A
cracked mirror hangs on one wall, and a pair of mismatched boots stands
by the door. Damp has swollen the floorboards into waves. The street
outside lies to the west.

13355.name: Walking The Streets

north.description: To the north lies Walking The Streets.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Stone Building.

south.description: To the south lies A Large Stone Building.

west.description: To the west lies Walking The Streets.

13355.description:
Four ways meet at this crossing of the streets, and a worn stone post
stands at its middle, hung with rusted shackles. Torches burn in a ring
of iron baskets, throwing long jumpy shadows over the housefronts. Pools
of dark liquid lie between the cobbles. A street runs north and another
west, a door to the east opens into a small house, and a larger doorway
to the south leads into a bigger hall.

extra_descs.post shackles stone:
The stone post is worn smooth at chest height by bodies that strained
against it. The shackles are rusted through but the bolts are still
bright, as if someone oils them.

13356.name: A Small Stone Building

west.description: To the west lies Walking The Streets.

13356.description:
A rough stone room with a low ceiling and a pallet of heaped furs along
one wall. Blades whetted to a ragged edge lie across a trestle, and a
chipped grindstone sits beside it, the floor around it silvered with
filings. The air is heavy with sweat and oil. The door to the west
returns to the street.

13357.name: A Large Stone Building

north.description: To the north lies Walking The Streets.

13357.description:
Long benches of rough-hewn timber fill this hall, and the stone floor is
worn pale by many boots. A great firepit dug in the middle holds a heap
of cold ashes and a rusted spit. Torn banners and a rack of broken
spears hang on the walls beneath a roof black with soot. The only door
is to the north, onto the street.

13358.name: Walking The Streets

north.description: To the north lies The Courtyard.

east.description: To the east lies Walking The Streets.

13358.description:
The street turns at a ragged corner where the cavern wall bulges close,
a seam of dripping rock glistening above the cobbles. A heap of broken
barrels and a dead cart wheel block part of the way. The drums here are
muffled to a heartbeat. The courtyard lies to the north and the street
goes on east.

13359.name: The Black Iron Gate

north.description: To the north lies At The Foot Of The Narrow Stairs.

south.description: To the south lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13359.description:
A gate of black iron bars as thick as a wrist fills an arch of hewn rock
here, its hinges as big as anvils and its spikes tipped in rust. Rows of
skulls are mounted on poles on either side. The lock is the size of a
child's head. The foot of the stairs lies north, and a door in the gate
opens south into the natural caves.

extra_descs.gate lock skulls:
The gate is cast in one piece, its bars blackened by fire and ringed
with gouges where hammers and axes have struck it. The skulls on the
poles grin in rows, some orc, some man, some far larger.

13360.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Black Iron Gate.

east.description: To the east lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13360.description:
Beyond the gate the tunnel becomes bare, natural cave with walls of grey
stone folded like cloth. A rusted chain trails from the gate behind, and
the floor is scuffed by many boots. The air is cooler and carries a
faint rank smell. The gate lies north and the cave runs on east.

13361.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

west.description: To the west lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13361.description:
The cave floor tips toward a narrow chute of smooth rock where water has
worn a long groove. Pale roots of some unseen plant hang from the roof
like fingers. A cracked cask lies at the lip. The cave runs west, and a
steep slope leads down.

13362.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

south.description: To the south lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

up.description: To the up lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13362.description:
Slabs of rock lean against each other in a tumble at the bottom of the
slope, forming low arches. A skein of cobweb stretches between them,
thick as rope. The ground is gritty with bone dust. A steep slope climbs
back up, and the cave goes south.

13363.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13363.description:
A natural vault of grey stone opens overhead, ribbed like the roof of a
giant mouth. Streaks of green and brown stain the walls where minerals
have seeped. A trickle of water runs in a groove down one wall to a dark
crack. The cave goes north and west.

13364.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13364.description:
The cave floor is covered in loose pebbles that roll underfoot with a
noise like rain. Small cairns of stacked stones stand here and there,
left as markers by someone. The air smells of damp earth. The cave goes
east and south.

13365.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13365.description:
A rounded chamber where three passages meet, the walls pitted with
hollows like honeycomb. Ropes of dried gut and a few scraps of fur
dangle from outcrops as trophies. A cold current moves overhead.
Passages lead north, south and west.

13366.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13366.description:
The cave opens into a wide gallery of folded grey stone, its roof
sagging like a heavy tent. Smears of soot mark where torches were
carried, and a rough heap of firewood lies stacked against a boulder.
The floor here is hard-packed and dry. Passages run north, east and
west.

13367.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

south.description: To the south lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13367.description:
A tight bend in the natural tunnel where the rock has weathered into
pillars like melted candles. A blackened pot sits on a ledge, long cold
and rimed with grease. Fine grey sand covers the floor and keeps every
print. The way goes south and west.

13368.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13368.description:
The cave twists downhill and then back, the walls ribbed and pale with
mineral crust. A knot of gnawed rope and a lost iron spike lie at the
corner. Faint chanting drifts up the passage, rising and falling. The
way goes east and south.

13369.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13369.description:
A shaft of grey rock plunges through the floor here, ringed with a crude
parapet of stacked stones. A ladder of lashed poles hangs into the
throat of the shaft and vanishes into the dark. Hot air breathes up
carrying a smell of smoke and sweat. Passages lead north and east, and
the ladder leads down to the grey tunnels.

13370.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13370.description:
Wet ripples of flowstone cover the walls here, glossy as molten wax, and
the floor is a cold, smooth skin of the same. Droplets form at the tips
of tiny stalactites and fall with sharp ticks. A trodden path winds on.
The cave leads north and east.

13371.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13371.description:
The cave narrows to a corkscrew passage, its floor patterned with worn
grooves. A bright vein of quartz crosses the wall, glinting wherever
torchlight touches it. A dry, metallic scent drifts along the passage,
like old coins. The cave leads north and back west.

13372.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

south.description: To the south lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13372.description:
A deep hole in the floor opens into a lower passage, ringed with scorch-
marks of a heat greater than any torch. The rock around it is glassy and
cracked. Warm air drifts up with a smell of hot metal. The cave leads
south, and a steep descent lies down.

13373.name: The Natural Cave-Tunnels

up.description: To the up lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies Before The Cave Of The Great Golden Dragon.

13373.description:
The passage drops in a steep stair of rough rock, lit from below by a
faint gold glow. Gold dust sparkles in the cracks, and a single coin has
been fused to the stone by heat. The air grows heavy and warm. The slope
climbs up, and descends to a great cavern below.

13374.name: Before The Cave Of The Great Golden Dragon

south.description: To the south lies Atop A Mountain Of Gold, Silver And Gemstones.

up.description: To the up lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13374.description:
A vast archway of natural rock yawns before you, big enough for a house
to pass through, and the cave floor beyond glitters. Gold coins lie
scattered across the threshold like spilled grain. Great claw-scratches
run along the walls at a height well above your head. The cave mouth
opens south, and a rough passage climbs up.

13375.name: Atop A Mountain Of Gold, Silver And Gemstones

north.description: To the north lies Before The Cave Of The Great Golden Dragon.

13375.description:
You stand atop a mountain of gold, silver and gemstones heaped in a
cavern so vast its roof is lost in dark. Coins slide and chime under
every step, and jewels glitter like a frozen sea of fire. A smell of hot
metal and ancient smoke hangs in the air. The only way off the hoard is
back north.

13376.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

up.description: To the up lies Entrance To The Smelting-Halls Of The Second Deep.

13376.description:
A broad stair rises from the tunnel through an open archway, toward a
ruddy glow of forge-light above. The ceiling here is blackened with
smoke, and the walls ring faintly with the clang of hammers. The way up
is open and well worn, and south the mine tunnel returns.

13377.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

south.description: To the south lies A Four-Way Junction In The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13377.description:
A straight stretch of mine tunnel with a double line of rusted rails
running down the middle and a cart tipped on its side. Pick marks cover
the walls in a dense lattice. North the tunnel climbs toward an archway,
and south it reaches a wider junction.

13378.name: A Four-Way Junction In The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13378.description:
A wide chamber where four mine tunnels meet, the roof held by a central
pillar of unmined rock painted with crude warnings. Tools lie scattered
around its base, and a lantern has been hooked to a nail. Ways lead out
north, east, south and west.

13379.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13379.description:
The mine tunnel doubles back in a tight loop, so that the way west
brings you right back where you started, a trick of the diggers' maze.
Cracked timbers prop the roof, and the dust is trodden into a hundred
overlapping prints. East the tunnel runs back toward the shored section.

13380.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13380.description:
The tunnel here is narrow and shored with split logs, each one bearing
the notched mark of some long-dead gang. Dust trickles from the roof at
the slightest vibration. South the way leads back down the tunnel, and
west it goes on.

13381.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13381.description:
A cross-cut where the mine tunnel dips into a rough puddle, the water
dark and oily. A wooden bucket on a rope hangs from a prop, half rotten,
and the timbers around it sag. The shaft continues north and west.

13382.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13382.description:
The mine tunnel turns around a thick pillar left standing in the rock,
its sides streaked with green copper stain. A pick with a broken haft
lies where it was dropped. East the tunnel runs on toward a bend, and
south it returns to the stair.

13383.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Chamber.

down.description: To the down lies An Ancient Staircase.

13383.description:
Props of black timber hold up the roof of this mine tunnel, and rails of
rusted iron run along the floor to a stack of broken carts. An ancient
stair gapes in the floor, descending into darkness. A heavy door to the
east leads into an old chamber, and the tunnel runs on north.

13384.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

east.description: To the east lies A Four-Way Junction In The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13384.description:
A long gallery shored with squared timber, its floor rutted by the
wheels of heavy carts. A shelf of rock holds the stub of a candle and a
flask long since drained. East the gallery opens toward the four-way
junction, and west it bends away.

13385.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13385.description:
Water seeps from the roof here and gathers in a trough along the foot of
the wall, feeding a pale growth of slime. A rusted ore trough lies
overturned, its rivets weeping red. East the tunnel runs toward the
great junction, and south it winds down.

13386.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13386.description:
A hairpin in the mine tunnel, where a rotted winch stands over a shaft
choked with rubble. The timbers creak softly under the weight of the
rock above. North the way leads on, and east it returns toward the
junction.

13387.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13387.description:
A three-way meeting in the mine, where a hand-lettered board nailed to a
prop has been scratched out beyond reading. Ruts in the floor show where
loaded carts were wheeled out. East the tunnel runs back toward the
bend, south it dwindles, and west it goes on.

13388.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

north.description: To the north lies A Four-Way Junction In The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13388.description:
The mine tunnel bends past a heap of tailings that has spilled across
half the floor. A wooden shovel with a split blade leans on the pile.
North the way returns to the junction, and west the tunnel carries on.

13389.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13389.description:
The mine tunnel ends in a half-dug face, the wall scarred by fresh pick
marks and the floor strewn with new rubble. A lantern stub burns on a
ledge, casting a small circle of light. The diggers stopped suddenly,
leaving their work. The one way back is the passage north.

13394.name: An Ancient Chamber

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

13394.description:
A square chamber older than the mine around it, with a ceiling of cut
stone slabs and a floor of cold black tile. Empty niches in the walls
once held urns, and a stone plinth stands in the centre, bare. The air
is dead and dry. A door in the west wall leads out to the mine.

13395.name: The Third Level Of Durgan's Chimney

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

up.description: To the up lies The Second Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

13395.description:
Here the great chimney reaches a wider ledge, ringed with rough pillars
of rock and a rail of rusted chain. A cold draught falls from above,
where the way up climbs to the higher landing, and a hot, rank wind
answers from the roaring dark. The ground is littered with ash and
charred splinters. Mine-tunnels lead away north and south.

13396.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Third Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

13396.description:
The tunnel slopes toward a larger space ahead, and the sound of wind in
a great shaft grows louder. Heavy wheel-ruts and drag-marks gather here
from all sides. Loose rock has been cleared in a rough path. The tunnel
runs north, and south it opens onto the chimney.

13397.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13397.description:
A dead lantern hangs from a hook, its glass cracked and its oil dried to
a black crust. The walls are streaked with orange where iron-rich water
has run. A scatter of pebbles clicks across the floor when the draught
stirs. The tunnel leads south and west.

13398.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13398.description:
The tunnel bends around a column of untouched rock left standing to bear
the roof, carved all over with squat, grinning faces. Offerings of
rusted nails and rat bones lie at its foot. The air is close and warm.
The way runs east and south.

13399.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13399.description:
A long, dull stretch of tunnel with rails of wooden planks laid along
its floor, half rotted away. The roof is low enough to scrape a tall
head, and soot has crept across it in a black film. Distant chanting
rolls faintly through the rock. The tunnel goes on both north and south.

13400.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13400.description:
Deep scratches cross the wall in wide arcs, as though a great set of
claws had dragged along the rock. A pile of rubble spills from a side
crack, and cold air hisses out. The timbers are splintered and sagging.
The tunnel runs north and west.

13401.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13401.description:
The floor slopes in a gentle curve, and a thin stream of water trickles
down it toward some lower drain. Green crust coats the rock where the
water runs. A broken shovel head sticks up from the trickle like a
tombstone. The tunnel turns east and back south.

13402.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13402.description:
A wide place in the tunnel where the walls have been chiselled into
rough alcoves, each holding a heap of ashes and charred bone. Black
smoke-stains climb the rock above them. A bitter smell hangs in the air.
Tunnels lead north, east and west.

13403.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13403.description:
The tunnel narrows to a shaft-like turn with the roof bulging overhead
and held up by splintered props. A few spilled coins of grey copper lie
in a crack. The air is still and sour. Passages lead out south and west.

13404.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13404.description:
A crossing where four galleries almost meet, the rock between them
hacked through in a hurry and left in jagged ledges. Bundled torches
stand in a stone niche. Boot-prints and the long drag-marks of sacks
cover the floor. Paths lead north, east and south.

13405.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13405.description:
A long straight stretch of tunnel, the floor worn to a glassy polish by
the passing of heavy carts. Pools of black water gather in the ruts. At
intervals, iron rings are set in the wall to hold lanterns. East and
west the tunnel stretches on.

13406.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13406.description:
Fresh pick-work shows here, where someone has begun to widen a side
seam, leaving a mound of rubble at its mouth. The props are new pine,
still sticky with sap. A coil of rope and a half-empty waterskin lie
abandoned beside them. The tunnel goes north and west.

13407.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Third Level Of Durgan's Chimney.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13407.description:
Sharp wheel-ruts curve around a wide chamber where timbers have been
stacked in neat rows. A great iron hook on a chain swings from the roof
beam, its point glinting. The floor is trampled bare of dust. Paths lead
north to the chimney ledge, east toward a doorway, and south.

13408.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

east.description: To the east lies Entrance To The Skull Clan's Dungeon.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13408.description:
The tunnel here is lined with heavy planks, and above the doorway ahead
a row of skulls is nailed to the lintel. Dried blood stains the floor in
a long rusty smear. Torchlight flickers beyond the threshold. The door
leads east into the clan's dungeon, and the tunnel runs west.

13409.name: Entrance To The Skull Clan's Dungeon

north.description: To the north lies Guardroom.

east.description: To the east lies The Mess Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Guardroom.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13409.description:
A broad guard-chamber of fitted stone, its roof carved with leering
skulls and its walls hung with chains and rusted gibbets. A great arched
doorway opens east into a hall of long tables. Heavy doors stand north
and south, each studded with iron. The mine-tunnels lie back west.

13410.name: Guardroom

south.description: To the south lies Entrance To The Skull Clan's Dungeon.

13410.description:
A cramped guardroom stinks of old sweat and spilled ale. A bench along
one wall, a table bearing a board scratched with dice squares, and a
rack of dented helmets fill the space. A barred slit looks into the hall
outside. The only exit is the door south.

13411.name: Guardroom

north.description: To the north lies Entrance To The Skull Clan's Dungeon.

13411.description:
This second guardroom is cold and bare except for a cot of stained
blankets and a barrel of black water. Dice, knucklebones and a greasy
pile of bone tokens lie scattered on the floor. A grille set in the door
looks back into the entrance hall. The door leads north.

13412.name: The Mess Hall

north.description: To the north lies Watch Hall.

south.description: To the south lies Watch Hall.

west.description: To the west lies Entrance To The Skull Clan's Dungeon.

13412.description:
Long tables of scarred timber fill this vaulted hall, their tops hacked
by knives and stained with a thousand meals. Iron cauldrons hang over a
pit of grey ash, and gnawed bones are heaped beneath the benches. Smoke
clings to the ceiling. Watch halls lead north and south, and the
dungeon's entrance lies west.

13413.name: Watch Hall

north.description: To the north lies A Filthy Barrack.

east.description: To the east lies The Goblin Lounge.

south.description: To the south lies The Mess Hall.

13413.description:
A long watch hall of cold stone, its walls lined with weapon racks and a
frieze of crude tally-marks. Arrow slits pierce the wall, and a drum the
size of a barrel stands on a plinth. A heavy door leads north to a
barrack, a passage runs east toward a lounge, and the mess hall lies
south.

13414.name: The Goblin Lounge

east.description: To the east lies The Harem.

south.description: To the south lies The Weapon Storage.

west.description: To the west lies Watch Hall.

13414.description:
Cushions of moulting fur are heaped around a low table of chipped
marble, and a hanging lamp of beaten bronze burns with a greasy yellow
flame. Fouled wine cups lie among the pillows. A torn, wine-stained
curtain covers a door to the east. The watch hall lies west, and a
passage leads south to the weapon store.

13415.name: The Weapon Storage

north.description: To the north lies The Goblin Lounge.

east.description: To the east lies Hall Of The Goblin King.

south.description: To the south lies A Storage Room.

13415.description:
Racks of cleavers and spears climb to the roof of this cellar-like
store, each rack numbered in chalk. A barrel of arrowheads has spilled
across the flagstones. The smell of oil and rust catches in your throat.
Passages run north to the lounge, east into a grander hall, and south to
a storeroom.

13416.name: Hall Of The Goblin King

west.description: To the west lies The Weapon Storage.

13416.description:
A squat hall with a ceiling of black beams, and at its far end a throne
of piled skulls, lashed together with wire. Banners of rotten green
cloth sag from the rafters, each stitched with a crowned skull. Bowls of
old coins and loose gems lie around its foot. The only exit is west to
the weapon store.

extra_descs.throne skulls:
The throne is a heap of skulls, each wired to the next, with a cushion
of mouldering fur on the seat. A spiked iron crown hangs from a hook
above it.

13417.name: A Storage Room

north.description: To the north lies The Weapon Storage.

13417.description:
Sacks of mouldy grain and crates of salted meat are piled to the roof of
this room, their tops gnawed through. A row of casks marked in a clumsy
hand stands along the wall, one leaking onto the floor. The smell is
thick enough to chew. The only exit is north.

13418.name: Watch Hall

north.description: To the north lies The Mess Hall.

east.description: To the east lies A Storage Room.

south.description: To the south lies The Warg Dens.

13418.description:
A second watch hall, longer and colder than the first, with a row of
rusted halberds along the wall and a bench scarred by dagger-points. A
cracked horn hangs from a peg. Torches have burned down to stubs in
their sconces. The mess hall lies north, a storeroom east, and a door
south leads to the dens.

13419.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13419.description:
The tunnel runs straight and dry, with a gutter chiselled along one wall
to carry water away. Shreds of chain-mail and a crushed helm lie in the
gutter, rusted to the colour of the rock. A faint breeze carries a whiff
of woodsmoke. You can go north or south.

13420.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13420.description:
Three tunnels branch from a trampled floor, their mouths marked with
painted skulls in red ochre. A broken wheelbarrow lies on its side near
a mound of sorted ore. The din of drums is louder here. Ways run north,
east and west.

13421.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13421.description:
A wide, low gallery where the roof has been cut flat with tools and
timber props stand every few paces. Iron lamp-hooks are driven into the
props, their flames long dead. Handprints in soot smear the walls at
head height. The way leads south and west.

13422.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13422.description:
A pile of broken stone has been swept into one corner of this turn, and
the pick-marks on the wall are fresh and bright. A pair of wheel-ruts
runs through a spill of black gravel. The air is hot and tastes of grit.
The tunnel turns north and runs back west.

13423.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13423.description:
This is the landing of the deep tunnels, where the rope from the pit
hangs against a rock wall dark with old grease. The roof is propped by
timbers as thick as a man's waist, each branded with a crude skull.
Spilled slag crunches underfoot. The tunnel goes east and west.

13424.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13424.description:
The tunnel ends in a ragged heap of tailings where a recent collapse has
half blocked a side gallery. A bent iron cage stands on its side, its
door hanging by one hinge. The dust is thick and the air is stale. The
way runs north and east.

13425.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13425.description:
A busy junction of mine-tunnels where the floor is trodden to bare, hard
rock. A heap of broken picks, hoes and shovels stands in a rusty pile.
Black soot marks the ceiling above where torches have been carried for
years. Paths run off north, east and south.

13426.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13426.description:
The tunnel is split lengthways by a crack as wide as a hand, through
which a cold wind whistles. The flagging on the floor has buckled
upward. A tin cup and a tattered scrap of banner are wedged in the
cleft. The way leads north and south.

13427.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

west.description: To the west lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13427.description:
A narrow passage where the rock walls are rubbed shiny at shoulder
height by countless passing bodies. Stray nails and buckles lie in the
dust. The drumming rises from the floor here as a low pulse you feel in
your bones. The tunnel turns south and west.

13428.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

north.description: To the north lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13428.description:
Rock dust hangs in the air in a fine pale cloud, and the walls glitter
with flecks of mica. The ceiling is braced with crossed beams hung with
spider-silk. A dented bucket and a hammerless handle lie in a corner.
Tunnels lead north and east.

13429.name: The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep

east.description: To the east lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

south.description: To the south lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13429.description:
A low-roofed bend in the tunnels where the rock turns from grey to dull
rust. Streaks of green copper stain the wall, and someone has chalked a
rough map of the passages beside them. Footsteps seem to follow you
here. The tunnel runs on east, and also south.

13430.name: The Warg Dens

north.description: To the north lies Watch Hall.

13430.description:
Heaps of rancid straw and gnawed bone fill this foul den, and the stone
floor is slick with grease. Deep gouges mark the doorframe at the height
of a large beast's shoulder. Chains with heavy collars are fastened to
iron rings in the wall. The stench of wet fur is thick. The only way out
is the door north.

13431.name: A Filthy Barrack

south.description: To the south lies Watch Hall.

13431.description:
Rows of straw pallets fill this stinking barrack, trodden into black
mats and crawling with fleas. Cloaks, belts and a spare boot hang from
pegs driven into the stone. A dented bucket by the door serves as a
latrine. The only door opens south on the watch hall.

13432.name: The Harem

west.description: To the west lies The Goblin Lounge.

13432.description:
A dim chamber hung with threadbare silks the colour of old blood, their
fringes grubby with soot. A heap of cushions fills one corner, and a
brass incense burner has tipped over, spilling grey ash. The air is
thick with stale perfume. The one door leads back west to the lounge.

13433.name: A Damp Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies At The Foot Of The Narrow Stairs.

13433.description:
The tunnel is slick with condensation, and every surface beads and runs.
Mushrooms in grey clusters crowd the foot of the wall, and the rock
above sparkles with wet mica. Drips make a ceaseless pattering in the
dark. The tunnel goes north deeper in and south back to the stairs.

13434.name: A Damp Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Damp Tunnel.

13434.description:
A seam of rust-coloured stone runs through the wall, leaching a red
stain into the pools that gather on the floor. The roof lowers here, and
you must stoop beneath a sagging slab. The air smells of wet iron. The
tunnel bends, leading east or back south.

13435.name: A Damp Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Damp Tunnel.

13435.description:
Mud has gathered knee-high against one wall in a smooth bank, scored
with the marks of many dragging feet. A cold breath comes and goes along
the passage as if the rock itself were breathing. The sound of dripping
is closer. The way runs north and west.

13436.name: A Damp Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Damp Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

13436.description:
The damp tunnel forks here at a pool of standing water, its surface
skinned with a pale film. Stalactites hang low over a short side passage
that stops in a dead end. Bones of small things crunch in the muck. Ways
lead east and south, and a short stub runs west.

13437.name: A Dead End

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Tunnel.

13437.description:
A short dead end where the tunnel gives out against a bulging wall of
wet clay. Footprints of many sizes cross the floor and all turn back, as
if their owners had thought better of it. The air is stale and tastes of
old pennies. Only the passage east leads out.

13438.name: A Damp Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Damp Tunnel.

13438.description:
The roof rises into a narrow chimney where a thread of cold air whistles
down, and the floor is a shelf of wet flowstone. Pale lichen glows
faintly in the cracks. Claw marks as long as your hand score the wall at
shoulder height. The tunnel leads north and back west.

13439.name: A Damp Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Damp Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Damp Tunnel.

13439.description:
Three damp tunnels meet at a low junction where the floor is a mass of
cracked mud. A rusted pick lies half buried, its haft eaten by rot.
Water drips in a steady rhythm from three separate points, each with its
own note. Ways lead east, south and west.

13440.name: A Damp Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Dead End.

west.description: To the west lies A Damp Tunnel.

13440.description:
The tunnel narrows and stoops, ending at a wall of fallen stone with a
crooked gap at its foot. A trail of slime glistens along the floor
toward the gap. The smell of rot is heavy. A low way leads south into a
dead end, and the tunnel runs back west.

13441.name: A Dead End

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Tunnel.

13441.description:
This is a cramped pocket of wet rock, ending in a blank wall hung with
dripping stone teeth. A mat of white threads covers the floor, and a
rusted lamp lies crushed in a corner. The silence is dense. The only way
out is north.

13442.name: A Damp Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Damp Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

13442.description:
The tunnel splits around a column of flowstone as thick as a barrel,
glossy and cream-coloured. A crust of salt rimes the floor, crunching
underfoot. Somewhere in the dark a pebble clicks and goes still. You can
go north, east, or west into a short dead end.

13443.name: A Dead End

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Tunnel.

13443.description:
A blunt stub of tunnel ends in a wall of smooth, dripping rock. Someone
has scratched a crude eye into the stone with a nail, and below it a
tally of lines. Puddles stand in the hollows of the floor, black and
still. The way out is east.

13444.name: A Damp Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Damp Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies At The Dark Pit.

13444.description:
The tunnel runs on beside a ledge of black rock, and a draught blows
along it from the west, smelling of hollow depth. Droplets fall from the
roof into a long trough in the floor. The walls are crusted with crystal
like dull sugar. A tunnel goes south, and west the passage ends at a
pit.

13445.name: At The Dark Pit

east.description: To the east lies A Damp Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Third Deep.

13445.description:
A round pit yawns in the floor of this chamber, its edges worn smooth
and its depth lost in blackness. A stone dropped into it falls for a
long time before any sound comes back. Frayed ropes lie coiled beside an
iron ring set in the rock. The tunnel runs east, and the way down leads
to the tunnels of the third deep.

extra_descs.pit ring ropes:
The iron ring is thick as a wrist and set deep in the rock, the rope
through it worn pale where it has been hauled many times. Nothing but
darkness lies below.

13446.name: An Ancient Staircase

up.description: To the up lies The Mine-Tunnels Of The Second Deep.

down.description: To the down lies An Ancient Staircase.

13446.description:
The stair climbs out of solid rock into a chamber of rough cutting at
its top. Fresh pick marks scar the walls where the orcs have widened the
old way, and a rope hangs coiled on a peg. The steps lead down into the
ancient depths, and a rough ramp climbs up into the mine tunnels.

13447.name: An Ancient Staircase

up.description: To the up lies An Ancient Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies An Ancient Staircase.

13447.description:
A wide landing interrupts the stair. In the middle, a stone bowl on a
plinth is crusted with ancient wax, and narrow slots in the wall once
held torches. The steps lead up toward the mines and down into the old
depths.

13448.name: An Ancient Staircase

up.description: To the up lies An Ancient Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies An Ancient Staircase.

13448.description:
The steps turn here, the stair twisting about a thick newel of pale
stone carved with ropes. A cold draught flows down from above, and
faint, hollow sounds carry from the dark. The old stone is cracked but
sound underfoot. You may climb up or descend.

13449.name: An Ancient Staircase

up.description: To the up lies An Ancient Staircase.

down.description: To the down lies At The Bottom Of An Ancient Staircase.

13449.description:
The stair rises in a straight run of broad steps, each worn smooth in
its middle. Carved handrails of stone, thick with dust, climb the wall
on either side. The way leads up into the dark, or down to a landing.

13450.name: At The Bottom Of An Ancient Staircase

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

up.description: To the up lies An Ancient Staircase.

13450.description:
Here the stair ends in a broad, round landing, its lowest step half sunk
in a skin of fine silt. The walls curve inward, stained by long seepage,
and the air is thick and cold. The stair rises into darkness above, and
a passage leads north.

13451.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies At The Bottom Of An Ancient Staircase.

13451.description:
The corridor slopes downward in a gentle ramp. Deep grooves are worn
into the floor, as though heavy carts once were hauled along it. The
walls are lined with rusted iron sconces, empty and crumbling. North the
passage runs on to the stone tree, and south the ground falls toward the
foot of a stair.

13452.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies By The Stone Tree.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13452.description:
A narrow corridor with a floor of grey slabs, each marked by a faint
circle. The air here is chill and moves slowly in a steady draught from
the south. A scatter of stone leaf-shapes lies near the far end, fallen
from the tree. North the stone tree stands in its hall, and south the
corridor runs on.

13453.name: By The Stone Tree

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13453.description:
A huge tree of grey stone rises from the centre of this hall, its trunk
as wide as a hut and its branches spreading across the vault in a frozen
canopy. Carved leaves lie scattered across the floor like fallen
foliage. Narrow ways lead out: north into the passage, east and south
into dim corridors.

13454.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies By The Stone Tree.

13454.description:
A short connecting passage whose floor is strewn with carved stone
leaves shed from the tree beyond. The walls bear a long inscription in
curling script, so worn that only a few signs remain. West the corridor
opens into the hall of the stone tree, and east it runs on.

13455.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13455.description:
The passage rounds a corner and climbs a little toward the north. A
niche holds a broken stone cup, its rim chipped, with a long-dead lamp
beside it. The floor is dry and clean, as if swept by an unseen draught.
West the passage returns toward the hall of the tree.

13456.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13456.description:
A junction of three passages, the stone floor worn into a wide, shallow
bowl by long-gone feet. A rusted iron ring is set high in the wall, from
which a long chain hangs down to the floor. North the passage runs on
beyond a rise, east it returns to the bronze doorway, and south it falls
toward a lower bend.

13457.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13457.description:
A sealed doorway of bronze stands in the wall, its leaves fused shut by
verdigris and age. A pattern of coiled serpents is cast across both
leaves, each coil as thick as your arm. The passage itself continues
east and west on either side of it.

13458.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13458.description:
A long straight stretch where the walls are inlaid with fading tiles of
blue and ochre, most fallen and shattered on the floor. Patterns of
stars and moons can still be made out in the few that remain. East and
west the corridor runs on, perfectly level.

13459.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13459.description:
The passage curves around a broad pillar thick with carved vines and
flowers, the stone petals chipped by time. A pale crust of salt glitters
along the wall where water once ran. South the corridor falls away, and
west it leads on along a gentle curve.

13460.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13460.description:
The ceiling has cracked from end to end, and a fall of stone blocks half
the width of the passage. You squeeze past the rubble, scraping your
arms on the sharp edges. Beyond the pile the corridor runs north, and
south it returns to the pillars.

13461.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13461.description:
Square pillars flank the way, their faces covered in bands of fine
geometric carving. At the base of one pillar lies a toppled bronze
brazier, green with age. A faint, sweet smell of old incense lingers,
though it must be centuries gone. The passage continues north and south.

13462.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13462.description:
A dry channel runs down the centre of the floor, once a conduit for
water, now choked with pale sand. Rows of niches line both walls, each
holding a stone lamp shaped like a lotus, all dark and cracked. The
passage runs straight north and south.

13463.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13463.description:
A lintel of dark stone spans the passage, carved with a ring of
interlocking runes too old to read. Dust lies so fine and undisturbed
that your footprints seem the first in a very long while. The corridor
turns here, running north and west.

13464.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13464.description:
Time has rounded the corners of this passage until it seems poured
rather than cut. A frieze of shallow reliefs runs along the wall at eye
level, its figures worn to ghosts of tall men with spears. The floor
dips toward the east where the corridor turns, and south it returns to
the shaft.

13465.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

down.description: To the down lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13465.description:
The tunnel is older than the orcs: its walls are cut in neat blocks
fused together by age, the corners rounded by time. A round hole in the
floor drops through the rock to a lower turn of the tunnel. The way
north runs on along the passage. Cold air rises from the hole with a
faint, mineral smell.

13466.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies By The Stone Tree.

13466.description:
The passage opens into a wider hall where the vault is lost in shadow
overhead. Ahead, pale branches of stone spread across the ceiling,
springing from something large and still. The air is cooler here and
carries a faint mossy smell. North the corridor turns back, and south
the hall goes on.

13467.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13467.description:
The passage drops a pace and turns, as if its makers wanted to throw off
pursuit. A rough drawing in soot of a great tree covers part of the
wall. The air carries a green, mossy tang, strange so deep in the stone.
South the way slopes down, and west it returns to the corridor.

13468.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13468.description:
A series of shallow alcoves is cut into the wall at knee height, each
holding a handful of crumbled grey powder. Fine cracks web the ceiling,
and a few chips of fallen plaster lie scattered about. East and west the
corridor continues.

13469.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13469.description:
The corridor turns a hard corner, and a drift of fine grey ash has
gathered against the inside of the bend. A single bronze ring is set in
the floor, too corroded to lift. A faint trickle of running water sounds
from somewhere beyond the wall. North the passage goes back toward the
straight stretch, and east it heads on.

13470.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage
