north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13470.description:
The floor is paved here with big black flags, laid in a perfect lattice
that time has hardly touched. Each flag bears a small sunken mark, a
circle crossed by two lines. The corridor continues north and south
along the same unbroken line.

13471.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13471.description:
A thin seam of white quartz runs the length of the wall like a frozen
river, catching what little light you carry. The air is dry and tastes
of stone dust, and the floor is smooth and level. The corridor goes
straight north and south, unbroken in either direction.

13472.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13472.description:
A long, plain corridor, its smooth walls bare of any carving, its floor
rubbed hollow by the steps of ages gone. A drop of water falls from the
vault every few heartbeats. Northward the corridor goes back toward a
bend, and southward it runs on.

13473.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13473.description:
The passage bends around a huge boulder fallen from above and wedged in
the corridor so tightly that only a narrow gap remains. Gravel crunches
underfoot. East the corridor runs on, and south it falls toward a long
straight stretch.

13474.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13474.description:
A colonnade of squat, round columns lines the passage, each carved with
spiralling bands. A faint, cold glow of luminous moss clings to the base
of the stone and gives just enough light to see by. East and west the
passage goes on.

13475.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13475.description:
The tunnel narrows and the ceiling lowers, the carved vaults giving way
to bare, rough-hewn stone. The old builders seem to have run out of
patience here. South the way leads back to the corner, and west it opens
into a longer corridor.

13476.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13476.description:
The passage corners around a stout buttress, with a stone bench set into
the wall in its lee. Somebody once scratched a plan into the soft stone,
though the lines are too worn to follow. A cold breath moves in from the
north. East the corridor runs back.

13477.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13477.description:
Faint traces of old paint cling to the walls: bands of red and gold,
blurred by centuries of damp. A line of tiny holes in the floor marks
the place of a long-vanished gate. The corridor runs east and west.

13478.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13478.description:
A great slab has fallen from the ceiling and lies crooked across the
floor like an overturned table. Its surface bears a half-effaced map of
channels and chambers, as if the ancients had carved their own halls in
miniature. South the passage runs back to the narrow throat, and west it
leads on.

13479.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13479.description:
The corridor narrows here to a throat barely wide enough for two men to
walk abreast. The walls glisten with a thin film of moisture, and a
hollow dripping sound echoes up and down the passage. North and south
the corridor runs on.

13480.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13480.description:
A tall archway of fitted blocks opens to one side, where a lower passage
heads off into the dark. The main corridor carries on north and south,
and east lies the archway. A band of carved leaves runs along the top of
the wall, each leaf as long as a hand.

13481.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13481.description:
A narrow connecting passage, low in the ceiling, where the old stone
gives way to rough-cut rock. Pick marks run in long diagonal lines.
Water drips from a seam into a hollow in the floor. West the passage
returns to the archway, and east it runs on.

13482.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13482.description:
A crossing of ways where a worn carving of a spiral is set in the floor,
the stone around it polished smooth. Flecks of silver glimmer in the
rock overhead. North a longer corridor stretches away, east the passage
opens toward a narrower tunnel, and south it descends toward the
junction.

13483.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13483.description:
A level passage whose walls are lined with iron brackets, once bearing
torches for a long-vanished guard. Rust has eaten them into flakes that
litter the floor. A slight draught carries a smell of char from the far
end. West the passage opens into the spiral crossing, and east it runs
on.

13484.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13484.description:
A cramped dogleg in the tunnel where the old builders' work ends in raw
rock. A broken lantern lies on the floor, its glass cracked and its wick
black. North the way climbs toward a small junction, and west it joins a
straighter passage.

13485.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13485.description:
A small junction hollowed from the rock, its walls blackened by an old
fire. A heap of charred timber and bent iron lies in one corner, and the
roof is crusted with soot. Three ways lead out: east, south and west.
The air smells of char.

13486.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13486.description:
The corridor widens into a rough chamber with a low central pillar.
Long, parallel scratches climb the wall almost to the roof, deep in the
stone. North a passage lined with niches leads away, while east and west
the tunnel carries on.

13487.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13487.description:
The tunnel bends here between walls of smooth dark stone dotted with
pits where water has etched the rock. Dripping echoes long and strange.
A heap of broken pottery lies in one corner. West the way returns to the
chamber, and south it turns on.

13488.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13488.description:
The walls of this passage have been chiselled with rows of hand-sized
symbols, each a looped knot. A seam of rust-red stone crosses the floor
like a scar. Water beads on the carvings and trickles from them in thin
lines. North the way returns toward a bend, and east the passage
continues.

13489.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13489.description:
A low, rounded passage, its roof so smooth that it seems to have melted
into shape. Fine pale sand lies in drifts against the walls, and the air
carries a faint tang of sulphur. West the corridor goes back, and south
it runs on.

13490.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13490.description:
The floor is cracked into huge plates, tilting where the earth has
settled. Scorch marks streak the walls in long, ragged tongues, black
against the pale stone, as if something had breathed fire along the
passage. A dry heat lingers in the air. The corridor runs north and
south from here.

13491.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13491.description:
The scorching grows worse: the walls are fused to glass in places, and
the floor is covered with shards of melted rock that crunch like brittle
shells. A great, wet smell of musk drifts up from the way ahead. North
and south the passage runs on.

13492.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Nesting-Place Of The Terrasque.

13492.description:
A vast archway opens into the dark, its edges rubbed smooth by the
passage of something enormous. Claw-furrows as long as a man's arm cut
into the walls on either side. A stench of old blood rolls out of the
gloom. North the corridor goes back, and south the nest begins.

13493.name: The Nesting-Place Of The Terrasque

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13493.description:
A great cavern floor of trampled, scorched rock and heaps of splintered
bone. The nest itself is a ring of piled boulders, lined with torn mail,
bent shields and gnawed timber, large enough for a monster to curl up
in. The air is hot and stinks of char and blood. Only the passage north
leads out.

13494.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13494.description:
A narrow corridor lined with niches, each hung with the rotted remains
of cloth and strings of beads. A heavy sweetness lingers in the air,
mixed with ancient dust. North and south the corridor runs on, straight
as a spear.

13495.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13495.description:
Webs of pale silk hang from the ceiling in thick curtains, swaying
though no breeze can be felt. The walls are crusted with a grey fur of
dust and old webbing, and a chill creeps up your spine. The corridor
runs north and south, with the webs growing denser to the north.

13496.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

west.description: To the west lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13496.description:
Skeins of grey silk cross the passage at every height, forcing you to
duck and stoop. The stone is slick with a clear, tacky film that clings
to your boots. South the way returns to the thinner webs, and west it
winds on.

13497.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

east.description: To the east lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13497.description:
The passage bends here, and the webs are thick as sailcloth, their
strands as heavy as rope. The floor is strewn with scraps of cloth and
splintered bone, picked clean. East the corridor goes back, and south it
leads toward a larger darkness.

13498.name: An Ancient Tunnel Passage

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

south.description: To the south lies The Lair Of Atlach Nacha.

13498.description:
The corridor ends in a huge arch hung with great curtains of white silk
that stir with a slow, sick rhythm. A cold, sour smell pours out from
the chamber beyond. The floor is rutted with long, spindly tracks. North
the corridor runs back, and south the lair waits.

13499.name: The Lair Of Atlach Nacha

north.description: To the north lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13499.description:
A vast domed cavern, its roof lost in a mist of silk. Great cables of
web stretch from wall to wall in a nightmare lattice, and the floor is
thick with white sheets of it and crumbling bones. A smell of acid and
decay lies heavy. The only way out is the passage north.

13600.name: In The Grey Tunnels

west.description: To the west lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies The Natural Cave-Tunnels.

13600.description:
The ladder comes out into the grey tunnels, a smooth passage of dull
stone that holds no trace of colour. The walls are scored with endless
parallel lines left by some great chisel. The torches are thinner here,
and the shadows lie thick. The passage leads west, and the ladder climbs
up.

13601.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

13601.description:
The grey passage turns at a sharp elbow, the corner worn smooth by the
shoulders of countless passing bodies. A ring of black soot marks where
a fire once burned in the middle of the floor. Drumbeats echo down the
walls from a long way off. The way leads east and south.

13602.name: Crossway Of Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Grey Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies At The T-intersection.

13602.description:
Four grey tunnels cross here in a broad chamber, with a squat pillar of
natural rock in the middle. Each tunnel mouth is marked by a pile of
stones with a skull set on top. The floor is trodden bare and dry.
Tunnels run north, east, south and west.

13603.name: In The Grey Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies At The T-intersection.

13603.description:
A wide stretch of grey tunnel, its walls scarred by a hundred passes of
wagon axles. A sour draught blows from the crossway ahead, carrying
faint sounds of distant drums. North the passage opens to a crossing of
tunnels, and south it narrows toward a branching.

13604.name: At The T-intersection

north.description: To the north lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

13604.description:
Three passages meet in an irregular junction, the west branch dwindling
to a blind pocket. Marks of dragged sacks cross the floor, converging on
the northern mouth. North the grey tunnel climbs toward a crossway,
south it bends away, and west a short arm ends in a dead end.

13605.name: A Dead End

east.description: To the east lies At The T-intersection.

13605.description:
A cul-de-sac where the tunnel gives up in a tumble of stones. A hollow
in the rock holds a heap of discarded rope and broken picks, long
untouched, and cobwebs sag between them. Nothing more lies here, and
nothing stirs. Back east is the only way to go.

13606.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies At The T-intersection.

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13606.description:
The tunnel bends sharply, the roof dropping to a crawl before lifting
again. A shallow basin in the floor holds still, black water that
mirrors your light. North the way leads to a meeting of passages, and
east the straighter tunnel runs back.

13607.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13607.description:
A long, silent stretch of grey tunnel, about the width of a cart, its
roof smooth and scoured. The floor tilts a little as it goes, and loose
pebbles skitter ahead of your feet. East the tunnel bends, and west it
turns the other way.

13608.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies At The T-intersection.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13608.description:
The tunnel turns around a squat knob of black stone, polished by the
shoulders of passers-by. A stripe of red ochre has been smeared across
the wall at head height. North the way leads to a branching, and west a
grey tunnel runs on.

13609.name: At The T-intersection

north.description: To the north lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Dead End.

13609.description:
The tunnel splits in a T here, one arm ending a few paces off in a blind
pocket. Streaks of black soot stain the ceiling above the joint. North
the passage continues grey and long, south it winds on to a bend, and
west a short arm stops at the dead end.

13610.name: A Dead End

east.description: To the east lies At The T-intersection.

13610.description:
The tunnel stops against a wall of fissured, crumbling stone. Fine grey
powder runs from the cracks and settles on the floor in neat little
cones. A few stout props lean against the rock, waiting to be used. You
can only return east.

13611.name: In The Grey Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies At The T-intersection.

south.description: To the south lies At The T-intersection.

13611.description:
A stretch of grey tunnel with walls like wet slate, veined with thin
lines of white calcite. Your footsteps double and redouble in the echo.
North the passage leads to a meeting of ways, and south another splits
off below.

13612.name: At The T-intersection

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Grey Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13612.description:
The tunnel forks in a rough T where a ledge of rock splits the passage
in two. Scratched into the ledge is a crude map of arrows and skull
signs. A cold, stale wind blows along the grey stone. Three ways branch
off, east, south and west.

13613.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies At The T-intersection.

west.description: To the west lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

13613.description:
The grey passage runs straight and level, as if ruled, with walls so
smooth they reflect torchlight dully. A line of black handprints marches
along the stone at shoulder height. Dust lies undisturbed in the
corners. The grey passage runs on, east and west.

13614.name: At The T-intersection

east.description: To the east lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13614.description:
The tunnel meets another at right angles, forming a T where the stone is
scuffed by many tracks. A rough arch of grey slabs frames the east
branch, while the west branch drops into shadow. South the way leads
back around the turn. Someone has chalked a crude arrow on the wall,
then scratched it out.

13615.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Dead End.

east.description: To the east lies At The T-intersection.

13615.description:
The passage doglegs between two outcrops of pale stone, then dips toward
a blind end. Droplets fall in a slow, steady rhythm from a stalactite
hanging low overhead. East the way returns to the T-junction, and north
it runs a short way into a pocket of rock. The floor is damp and cold
underfoot.

13616.name: A Dead End

south.description: To the south lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13616.description:
The tunnel ends in a blank wall of grey stone where the diggers gave up
or were driven off. A heap of fallen rubble lies at the foot of the
wall, and old pick marks crowd the rock face in a frenzy of half-cuts.
It is cold and silent here, the air heavy with dust. The only way out is
back south.

13617.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies At The T-intersection.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13617.description:
The grey tunnel turns sharply here, as though the old diggers had struck
a hard seam and veered around it. Water runs down the wall in a thin
silver thread and vanishes in a crack. North the passage runs on to a
meeting of ways, and west it returns to the straighter tunnel. The floor
is polished by passing feet.

13618.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Travelled Path.

13618.description:
The path narrows into a tunnel of smooth grey stone, bare of paint or
carving and cold to the touch. Your footsteps ring flat and dead against
the walls. West the passage opens back into the cavern and the path, and
east it runs deeper into the hill. A single guttering torch burns in a
bracket at the mouth.

13619.name: The Travelled Path

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies The Travelled Path.

west.description: To the west lies The Travelled Path.

13619.description:
The path forks at a heap of rubble stones, one branch ducking east into
a narrow grey tunnel, the other bending west toward a broader way. A
rusted signpost leans here, its arms snapped and its painted words worn
to smears. Pale streaks of lichen stain the roof far above. South the
path runs back toward the dump.

13620.name: The Travelled Path

north.description: To the north lies The Travelled Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Travelled Path.

13620.description:
The path runs straight and level here between low ridges of broken
stone, packed hard by years of marching. Chalk marks and daubed red
handprints cover a standing slab beside the road. The air smells of
smoke and cooking fat from some distant hearth. The path leads north to
a fork and south back toward the dump.

13621.name: The Travelled Path

north.description: To the north lies The Travelled Path.

south.description: To the south lies The Dump.

13621.description:
A broad path of beaten earth, rutted by cart wheels and the tramp of
many boots, winds through the great cavern. Rough cairns of stone mark
its edges, and black iron lamp-posts stand at long intervals, their oil
long burned dry. The cavern roof is lost in darkness overhead. North the
path runs on toward the town, and south it ends at the rubbish heap.

13622.name: The Dump

north.description: To the north lies The Travelled Path.

down.description: To the down lies Under The Dump.

13622.description:
A mountain of the orcs' rubbish is heaped in this great cavern: broken
pots, bones, rusted mail and rotten timbers spill down in a slow
avalanche. Thin smoke curls from smouldering patches, and the stench
catches in your throat. A hole in the heap, ringed with trampled filth,
slides down into the passages below. North a hard-packed path leads away
from the stink.

13623.name: The Travelled Path

north.description: To the north lies Before The Gates.

east.description: To the east lies The Travelled Path.

13623.description:
The path broadens and climbs a little as the cavern opens ahead, its
floor smoothed by countless feet. Iron-bound posts line each side, hung
with skulls and rags, and a tang of woodsmoke drifts down from the walls
of the town. North lies the gate, and east the path leads back to the
fork.

13624.name: Before The Gates

north.description: To the north lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

south.description: To the south lies The Travelled Path.

13624.description:
Before you rises the gate of Burzuk, a wall of black timber and iron
spikes bound to the cavern rock. Heavy double doors stand ajar to the
north, scarred with axe cuts and daubed with crude red glyphs. Torches
in iron cages light the approach, throwing wild shadows over the packed
earth. South the path leads back across the cavern.

13625.name: Under The Dump

east.description: To the east lies Under The Dump.

south.description: To the south lies Under The Dump.

west.description: To the west lies Under The Dump.

up.description: To the up lies The Dump.

13625.description:
A wide, low chamber beneath the dump, where the roof is held up by tree-
trunk props black with damp. A sloping chute of packed rubbish and clay
climbs up toward the heap above. Passages lead east, south and west from
here, trodden hard by many feet. Shards of pottery crunch underfoot like
dry leaves.

13626.name: Under The Dump

east.description: To the east lies Under The Dump.

south.description: To the south lies Under The Dump.

13626.description:
A narrow, sagging gallery under the dump, propped with rotting beams
that groan when the ground above shifts. Mouldy rags hang from the beams
like grey cobwebs. The way east opens toward a wider chamber, and south
it returns to the shaft. Every crack in the ceiling weeps a thin,
stinking drip.

13627.name: Under The Dump

north.description: To the north lies Under The Dump.

east.description: To the east lies Under The Dump.

down.description: To the down lies In The Tunnels.

13627.description:
Beneath the great refuse heap the roof sags, and thin rivulets of foul
liquid seep down through the rock. A hole in the floor drops away to a
lower tunnel, ringed by rusted iron rungs. The cavern continues north
and east over ground littered with broken crockery, fish bones and rags.
The smell of rot is almost solid.

13628.name: Under The Dump

north.description: To the north lies Under The Dump.

east.description: To the east lies Under The Dump.

west.description: To the west lies Under The Dump.

13628.description:
A cross passage beneath the dump where seepage has pooled into a
stagnant, rainbow-skinned puddle. Wooden props lean at drunken angles,
and the ceiling is crusted with a pale, wet fungus. Paths lead north to
the wide chamber, east toward a junction of rubble and west to the
shaft. A cold draught stirs the dirt on the floor.

13629.name: Under The Dump

north.description: To the north lies Under The Dump.

east.description: To the east lies The Small Hideaway.

west.description: To the west lies Under The Dump.

13629.description:
The passage widens into a rubbish-strewn junction where a narrow crawl
opens in the far wall. Piles of rusted tin, bent nails and sodden
sacking line the walls. A path of flattened refuse leads north and west.
The crawl to the east is low and well worn, as though it is used every
day.

13630.name: Under The Dump

south.description: To the south lies Under The Dump.

west.description: To the west lies Under The Dump.

13630.description:
A dead-end pocket at the corner of the chamber, where the roof has
dropped low enough to brush your hair. The floor is deep in filth and
broken barrels, and thick webs of mould cover the walls. South the way
slips down toward another passage, and west it opens into the larger
chamber. The stale air hangs heavy and sweet with decay.

13631.name: The Small Hideaway

west.description: To the west lies Under The Dump.

13631.description:
A cramped hollow no bigger than a cart, hidden behind a curtain of rags
at the end of the crawl. A pallet of rotting straw lies in one corner,
and a crude shelf of stones holds a few cracked bowls and a stub of
tallow. Scrawls on the wall record some forgotten tally. The only way
out is back west through the crawl.

13632.name: Main Street Of Burzuk

north.description: To the north lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

east.description: To the east lies The Street Of Gore.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Gates.

west.description: To the west lies The Street Of Sorrow.

13632.description:
Just inside the gate the main street of Burzuk opens between squat
houses built of stone and scavenged timber. Smoke and torchlight roil
under the high cavern roof, and the noise of drums and shouting swells
in the air. Side streets branch east and west, the main street runs on
north, and the gate stands open to the south. The paving stones are
cracked and stained dark.

13633.name: The Street Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies The Street Of Sorrow.

east.description: To the east lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

13633.description:
The street runs north from the main road past a row of boarded doorways,
their planks nailed over with iron strips. Faded red paint on the wall
forms a long list of names that no one now reads. The air is quiet
compared with the drum-loud avenue to the east. The street continues
north, and east it leads back to the main street.

13634.name: The Street Of Gore

north.description: To the north lies The Street Of Gore.

west.description: To the west lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

13634.description:
The street ends at a wide corner where it meets the main road. A
crumbling wall of piled stones runs along one side, daubed with rows of
red handprints, and a rusted lantern hangs from a hook. The ground
slopes toward a clogged gutter. Gore Street runs north between its
hovels, and west a short walk brings you back to the main street.

13635.name: The Street Of Gore

north.description: To the north lies The Street Of Gore.

east.description: To the east lies Gurbang's Fine Bakery.

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Gore.

13635.description:
This stretch of the Street of Gore is stained a deeper brown where the
butchering trade is heaviest, and carcasses swing from iron poles. A
warm, yeasty smell drifts from the doorway to the east. Flat paving
stones are scored by wagon wheels. North the street runs toward a
cramped shop, and south it bends back toward the main road.

13636.name: Gurbang's Fine Bakery

west.description: To the west lies The Street Of Gore.

13636.description:
Heat rolls from a great clay oven in the back, and the air is thick with
the smell of black bread, charred crust and spiced fat. Slabs of dark
loaf are stacked on a floury counter beside a rack of hard flat cakes.
Smoke has stained the ceiling to a treacle brown. The way out leads west
to the street.

13637.name: Main Street Of Burzuk

north.description: To the north lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

south.description: To the south lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

13637.description:
The main street climbs gently between rows of low stone huts, their
doorways hung with hides and strings of dried gristle. Cart ruts run
deep in the packed dirt, and a stinking gutter crawls down the middle of
the road. Drumbeats roll from deeper in the town. The street continues
north, and the gate lies back to the south.

13638.name: The Street Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies The Street Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies Abandoned Orc Dwelling.

13638.description:
A narrow section of the street where the houses lean together over the
lane and shut out the torchlight. A dripping gutter pours a thin stream
across the stones, pooling in a cracked basin. To the west a dwelling
stands open and abandoned. North and south the lane runs on in the
gloom.

13639.name: Abandoned Orc Dwelling

east.description: To the east lies The Street Of Sorrow.

13639.description:
The roof of this dwelling has half collapsed, and a slope of rubble
covers the back wall. A cracked clay cooking pot sits in the ash of a
dead fire, and scraps of a woven mat curl along the floor. The air is
cold and smells of mildew. The doorway opens east on the street.

13640.name: The Street Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies The Street Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies Abandoned Orc Dwelling.

13640.description:
A silent stretch of the Street of Sorrow, where the lamps went dark long
ago. Mud from some old flood has dried to a grey crust over the stones.
The shuttered house to the west lies open to the street, a ragged dark
mouth. North the lane goes on toward the guard station, and south it
runs deeper into the quarter.

13641.name: Abandoned Orc Dwelling

east.description: To the east lies The Street Of Sorrow.

13641.description:
A cramped hovel where someone scratched a row of crude pictures across
the plaster: a sun, a hunting party, a long line of marching figures. A
splintered chest stands open and empty under the window slit, its lid
missing. Dust and cobwebs fill the corners. The way out is east to the
Street of Sorrow.

13642.name: The Street Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies The Street Of Sorrow.

east.description: To the east lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies The Orc Guard Station.

13642.description:
The Street of Sorrow is a drab lane of shuttered doorways and sagging
lintels where little life stirs. A stout door of iron-bound planks to
the west leads into the guard station, and a notice scratched beside it
is smeared with fingerprints. East the lane meets the broad main road,
while north and south it runs on between blank walls.

13643.name: The Orc Guard Station

east.description: To the east lies The Street Of Sorrow.

13643.description:
A bare stone guardroom lit by a single smoking cresset. Rows of pegs
hold dented helms and spears, and a rack of manacles hangs from the far
wall. A scarred table is covered with dice, knucklebones and a half-
eaten loaf. The only way out is east, through the door to the street.

13644.name: The Street Of Sorrow

north.description: To the north lies The Path Of Sorrow.

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies Abandoned Orc Dwelling.

13644.description:
Here the street falters into rubble, its houses burned to ash or
abandoned long ago. A doorless hovel gapes to the west, and charred
beams lie across the way. North the lane climbs into a wilder path, and
south it leads back toward the guard station.

13645.name: The Path Of Sorrow

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Sorrow.

west.description: To the west lies Cavern Of Sorrow.

13645.description:
A rough path of broken flagstones climbs away from the streets, flanked
by knee-high cairns and rusted iron spikes bearing faded scraps of
cloth. The cavern roof lowers here, and the cold seems to gather in the
air. West a black mouth in the rock leads into a cavern, and south the
path returns to the street.

13646.name: Cavern Of Sorrow

east.description: To the east lies The Path Of Sorrow.

down.description: To the down lies The Granite Stairs.

13646.description:
A round cavern of grey stone where the orcs lay their dead and their
grudges. Niches hold offerings of knucklebones, rusted blades and faded
cloth, each stacked with careful reverence. A cold breath rises from a
stair that spirals down into darkness at the far side. The mouth of the
cavern opens east onto the path.

13647.name: Main Street Of Burzuk

north.description: To the north lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

south.description: To the south lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

13647.description:
Here the main street widens into a muddy square lit by a ring of burning
braziers. A cracked stone trough stands in the centre, green with slime,
and war banners of scraped hide hang limp from tall poles. Smoke drifts
up toward the unseen roof. North the street runs toward a larger
junction, and south it returns toward the gate.

13648.name: Main Street Of Burzuk

north.description: To the north lies Abandoned Orc Dwelling.

east.description: To the east lies The Street Of Gore.

south.description: To the south lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

west.description: To the west lies The Street Of Sorrow.

13648.description:
A broad crossing at the heart of Burzuk, where the main street meets the
Street of Gore and the Street of Sorrow. A tall iron stake stands in the
middle, hung with chains and the bleached skulls of old enemies. North a
doorless hovel gapes dark and empty, while east and west the two streets
run off between crowded dwellings. The ground is packed hard by marching
boots.

13649.name: Abandoned Orc Dwelling

south.description: To the south lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

13649.description:
The doorway hangs broken, and inside the dwelling is one cramped room of
soot-blackened stone. A cold hearth fills one corner, heaped with old
ash, and a toppled bedframe of lashed poles lies against the wall. Dust
lies thick on everything, and someone has long since looted the shelves.
The only way out is south to the street.

13650.name: The Street Of Gore

north.description: To the north lies The Street Of Gore.

east.description: To the east lies Ragsha's Store For All.

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Gore.

13650.description:
The street narrows between tall, crooked tenements of rubble and timber
stacked like crates. Washing lines of hide are strung across the way,
sagging under tattered rags. A hanging sign made from a dented shield
marks the doorway to the east, where a lamp burns behind greasy skin.
North the street runs back toward the entranceway, and south it plunges
into a darker quarter.

13651.name: Ragsha's Store For All

west.description: To the west lies The Street Of Gore.

13651.description:
Shelves of rough planks rise to the ceiling, groaning under coils of
rope, tin pots, skinning knives, ill-matched boots and heaps of unnamed
junk. A counter of split barrels stands near the door, and a smoking
lamp hangs on a hook above it. Everything smells of tallow, leather and
dust. The only way out is the door west to the street.

13652.name: The Street Of Gore

east.description: To the east lies The Entranceway.

south.description: To the south lies The Street Of Gore.

west.description: To the west lies Main Street Of Burzuk.

13652.description:
The Street of Gore is lined with butchers' blocks and rusted hooks, and
the cobbles are slick with old stains. Dark runnels cut channels toward
a drain at the foot of the street. West the way leads back to the
crossing, east a great arched entranceway looms, and south the street
runs on between hovels. The smell is thick, metallic and unpleasant.

13653.name: The Entranceway

east.description: To the east lies The Waiting Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Street Of Gore.

13653.description:
A broad entranceway is cut into the living rock, flanked by two huge
pillars carved as snarling tusked faces. Iron-bound doors stand open on
their hinges, and the floor is worn into shallow dips by generations of
boots. West lies the street, and east a torchlit chamber. Across the
lintel runs a row of rusted spikes, each crowned with a blackened skull.

13654.name: The Waiting Chamber

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

west.description: To the west lies The Entranceway.

13654.description:
A long, smoky antechamber where petitioners are made to wait on benches
of rough-hewn stone. Banners of dyed hide hang from the walls, each
marked with the crude emblem of a red fist. A thick door of black timber
stands to the north, and the way west leads back to the entranceway. The
air is hot and heavy with sweat, and the drums sound loud.

13655.name: Abandoned Orc Dwelling

east.description: To the east lies The Street Of Sorrow.

13655.description:
The hovel is a single room with a floor of trampled dirt and a hearth
cold for many winters. Torn hides hang in strips from the rafters like
dead leaves, and a heap of broken pottery fills one corner. Rot has
taken the lintel and the door hangs from one hinge. The only exit is
east to the street.

13656.name: The Great Hall Of Orschnag

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

south.description: To the south lies The Waiting Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

13656.description:
You stand in the great hall of Orschnag, a cavern hewn into a hall, its
roof held up by pillars as thick as ancient trees. Torches smoke in
brackets the size of a man's arm, and the floor is strewn with rushes
and gnawed bones. Long tables of black wood run off in every direction.
The doors to the south lead out to the waiting chamber, and the hall
opens north, east and west.

13657.name: The Great Hall Of Orschnag

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

south.description: To the south lies The Waiting Chamber.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

13657.description:
A long table of black oak runs along this side of the hall, scarred by
cleavers and stained with spilled drink. Benches of split logs line it,
and a big iron cauldron hangs cold over a pit of embers. A doorway south
leads out to the waiting chamber, west the hall opens toward its centre,
and north the table runs toward a corner heaped with spoils.

13658.name: The Great Hall Of Orschnag

north.description: To the north lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

13658.description:
A corner of the hall crowded with barrels and sacks, the king's store of
drink and meal. The barrel-heads are branded with a fist, and spilled
grain crunches underfoot. Pillars of black rock lean over this corner,
dripping with condensation. North an alcove of weapon racks lies beyond,
and east the hall opens toward its heart.

13659.name: The Great Hall Of Orschnag

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

13659.description:
A shadowy part of the hall where racks of weapons stand against the
wall: pikes, axes, long curved knives and cruel mauls. The floor is
scuffed bare by drilling feet, and a ring of sand marks a fighting pit.
East the dais glows red beyond the pillars, and south the hall opens
into a broader space.

13660.name: The Great Hall Of Orschnag

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

13660.description:
Plunder from a hundred raids is piled in this corner of the hall: dented
shields, rolled carpets, chests with splintered lids and stacks of
notched blades. Smoke from the braziers is drawn up through a ragged
flue in the roof, leaving the air thick and bitter. West lies the dais,
and south the hall continues along a great table.

13661.name: The Great Hall Of Orschnag

east.description: To the east lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

south.description: To the south lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

west.description: To the west lies The Great Hall Of Orschnag.

13661.description:
At the head of the hall a dais of black basalt rises in three steps,
crowned by a high seat of iron and bone. Great braziers on chains throw
a lurid red glow across the roof, and tattered clan banners hang above,
each stitched with a bloody handprint. Skulls of beasts and men are
nailed in rows to the wall behind. To the east and west the hall
continues along the dais, and south it opens toward the middle of the
hall.

13662.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies At The T-intersection.

13662.description:
A long dim stretch of grey tunnel where the roof drops until you must
bow your head. Pale fungus grows in rows along the base of the walls, as
neatly spaced as a garden. The drumming is plainer here, a dull throb in
the stone. Beyond the low roof the tunnel carries on east and west.

13663.name: Crossway Of Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Grey Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies In The Grey Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13663.description:
A crossway of tunnels in a high, bell-shaped chamber with ancient torch-
brackets in the walls. Four wide paths lead from it, each worn into a
smooth channel by heavy traffic. A banner of black hide hangs ragged
from a spear stuck in a crack. Paths lead north, east, south and west.

13664.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies At The T-intersection.

west.description: To the west lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

13664.description:
The tunnel makes a sharp turn here between smooth walls of grey rock. A
heap of broken timber and a rusted axe-head lie in the corner, remnants
of some old skirmish. A cold draught flows in from the north, bringing
the smell of damp earth. West the way leads back to a crossing.

13665.name: In The Grey Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

13665.description:
The grey tunnel here is narrow and straight, with scorch marks streaking
the walls at intervals as though fire had been hurled along it. A
scatter of broken arrow shafts lies in the dust. The air tastes of cold
ash. North and south the tunnel stretches away.

13666.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies In The Grey Tunnels.

up.description: To the up lies An Ancient Tunnel Passage.

13666.description:
The tunnel turns at a corner where a spiral stair of old stone climbs
into the roof. Its treads are cracked and rimed with dust, and a
handrail of rusted iron winds beside them. Chill air spills down the
stair. The tunnel goes east and south, and the stair leads up.

13667.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies At The T-intersection.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13667.description:
The grey rock buckles here into a ripple, and the tunnel makes a lazy S.
Cobwebs hang in grey curtains from the roof, heavy with dust. A rotted
sack lies split open, spilling black grain. South and west the tunnel
carries on.

13668.name: At The T-intersection

north.description: To the north lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13668.description:
A T-shaped meeting of grey tunnels beneath a roof of cracked slate. A
weathered post stands in the middle, topped with a crude skull and hung
with strips of dried hide. The smell of old smoke is strong. Ways lead
north, east and south.

13669.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies At The T-intersection.

13669.description:
The tunnel is narrow and plain, without any marks of use but a thick
layer of dust and the trails of crawling things. The torch brackets are
empty, their iron red with rust. The air is dry and still. The tunnel
leads away east and west.

13670.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13670.description:
Roots of unknown plants grow thin through cracks in the roof, pale as
worms, and hang almost to the floor. The stone is damp and cool. A
rattle of loose gravel echoes from somewhere ahead. The tunnel runs east
and west.

13671.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies Old Portal Room.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13671.description:
The tunnel turns round a stout pillar of natural stone. On the pillar a
face has been hacked out of the rock, with eyes of dull red glass and a
grin ringed with chipped teeth. The floor slopes gently toward a portal
chamber. The passage goes west, and south toward a pale glow.

13672.name: Old Portal Room

north.description: To the north lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies At The T-intersection.

down.description: To the down lies The Small Tunnel.

13672.description:
A circular chamber of old stone, its floor inlaid with a worn ring of
runes around a cracked central slab. The portal that once stood here is
a ruin of blackened arches, dead to any magic. Dust whirls in the
draught as though stirred by unseen feet. Tunnels lead north and east,
and a small passage leads down.

extra_descs.portal arches runes slab:
The arches are cracked through and black with scorching, and the runes
round the slab have been chipped away on purpose. Whatever once passed
through here will not do so again.

13673.name: In The Grey Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Crossway Of Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies The Small Tunnel.

13673.description:
Here the cut tunnels give way to the natural grey rock of the deeps,
smooth as old bone and streaked with pale mineral veins. A cold air
stirs from a crossway ahead to the north, carrying the faint boom of
distant drums. At your feet a scramble of handholds drops into the
miners' small tunnel. The roof is lost in blackness above.

13674.name: The Small Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Small Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13674.description:
The small tunnel ends in a steep climb, with footholds chipped into the
rock rising to the grey tunnels above. Dust lies thick on the ledges,
and a rusted pick head sits wedged in a crack where some miner left it.
The passage returns east. Far off, something drips with the patience of
ages.

13675.name: The Small Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Small Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Small Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies In The Bend.

13675.description:
A hole gapes in the floor of the tunnel here, its edges worn smooth by
many boots, with footholds cut into the rock leading down. Below, the
passage drops toward a bend in the deeper tunnels. The bore runs east
and west past a pile of broken props. A stale draught rises from the
shaft smelling of wet stone.

13676.name: The Small Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Small Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Small Tunnel.

13676.description:
A tight bend in the narrow bore, where the roof drops so low that a tall
traveller must stoop. Water has stained long green streaks down the
wall, and a puddle shines in a pit of the floor. Pick marks cover the
stone on every side. The way runs north toward a stair and west along
the bore.

13677.name: The Small Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies The Small Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies Old Portal Room.

13677.description:
The tunnel here is a low square bore, its walls hacked by pick and
chisel and shored at intervals with blackened timbers. A stair of rough-
cut steps climbs up into the dark toward an old portal room. Iron rings
are set in the rock to hang lanterns, though only one still holds a cold
stub of tallow. The passage runs south from the foot of the steps.

13678.name: At The T-intersection

north.description: To the north lies A Dead End.

south.description: To the south lies In The Grey Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Old Portal Room.

13678.description:
A T of grey tunnel where a streak of rust-red mineral runs through the
stone like a vein of blood. A fallen torch lies charred on the floor,
and shreds of leather and cloth cling to the splintered rock. The air is
stuffy and warm. Ways lead north to a dead end, south, and back west.

13679.name: A Dead End

south.description: To the south lies At The T-intersection.

13679.description:
A short blind end where the grey tunnel peters out against a wall of
fractured stone. Someone has piled rocks in a rough cairn against it,
and a ring of old blood stains the floor. The air is still and tastes of
metal. The only way out is south.

13680.name: In The Grey Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies At The T-intersection.

south.description: To the south lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13680.description:
The grey tunnel dips and rises like a swell on a still sea. Along the
walls hang loops of rope and chain, strung with rusty bells that jingle
in the draught. The echoes slide away and come back wrong. The tunnel
goes north and south.

13681.name: In The Grey Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Grey Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13681.description:
A dry gallery, wide and high enough to stand a pair of wagons in, though
the floor bears no wheel-marks. Piles of broken pottery and bits of
charred wood lie heaped against the walls. A faint chanting seeps in
from the far end. The tunnel runs on both north and south.

13682.name: A Turn Of The Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies In The Grey Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13682.description:
The tunnel bends sharply around a wall of fused rock the colour of
cooled iron. Splashes of old paint, red and yellow, form crude patterns
up the stone. The torch smoke clings to the roof in a greasy layer. The
way leads north and east.

13683.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies In The Grey Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies A Turn Of The Tunnel.

13683.description:
The passage slopes slightly and is washed in the pale glow of fungus
clinging to the roof. Skulls have been set into the wall at intervals,
mouths agape, and each one holds a stub of candle. The floor is gritty
with ash. The passage continues east and west.

13684.name: In The Grey Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies The Temple.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13684.description:
The grey tunnel widens to a hall-like mouth, its roof carved with rows
of spikes. A strong smell of incense and burnt fat drifts from ahead,
mingled with the throb of a slow drum. Heavy boot-prints cross the floor
in drifts of ash. The temple lies to the east, and the tunnel runs west.

13685.name: The Temple

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies In The Grey Tunnels.

13685.description:
A low, soot-black temple where a great altar of slab stone stands before
a wall painted with a huge red eye. Braziers smoulder at every corner
and the floor is sticky with old offerings. Skull-lamps hang from chains
overhead, each burning with a sickly green flame. A door leads south
into a hallway, and the grey tunnel lies west.

extra_descs.altar eye wall:
The red eye on the wall is ten feet across, its pupil a pit of black
soot. The altar below it is stained brown in a pattern of long runnels.

13686.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Temple.

east.description: To the east lies Novice Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies The Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies Novice Quarters.

13686.description:
A long stone hallway of low arches, lit by a smoking torch at each end.
The floor is swept clean, and rough doors line both sides, hung with
strips of bright cloth. The smell of incense seeps through from the
north. A door to the east and another to the west lead to quarters,
while the hallway goes on south.

13687.name: The Hallway

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies Priest Quarters.

south.description: To the south lies Sanctuary Of Orcus.

west.description: To the west lies Priest Quarters.

13687.description:
A long hallway of black-veined stone runs through the heart of the
temple, lit by iron braziers burning a sullen red. Heavy doors stand
east and west, each marked with a clawed sigil, and an archway south
opens upon the sanctuary where incense hangs thick in the air. The
hallway goes on north into deeper gloom. Your footsteps ring on
flagstones worn into shallow dips.

13688.name: Novice Quarters

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

13688.description:
A cell-like room, its stone floor bare but for a row of narrow cots with
grey blankets folded square. A small shelf holds clay lamps, a wooden
bowl and a string of bone beads. The air smells of tallow and sleep. The
only door leads back west to the hallway.

13689.name: Novice Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Hallway.

13689.description:
Rows of straw pallets lie crowded along the walls of this long low room,
each with a folded blanket and a small clay lamp. A worn drill-board
hangs near the door, scored with chalked lessons in a crooked orcish
script. The room smells of tallow, sweat and cold stone. The only door
opens east onto the temple hallway.

13690.name: Priest Quarters

east.description: To the east lies The Hallway.

13690.description:
This narrow cell holds a rough bed, a washstand with a cracked bowl and
a shelf of mouldering prayer-scrolls. Somebody has scratched tally marks
along the wall beside the pillow, hundreds upon hundreds of them. A thin
curtain of black wool is tied back from the doorway east into the
hallway. The stone is cold and damp underfoot.

13691.name: Priest Quarters

west.description: To the west lies The Hallway.

13691.description:
A cramped chamber of bare stone where the temple priests sleep on
pallets of grey wool. A bronze lamp hangs from a chain, throwing a smoky
light over a wall hung with ritual knives and a faded black cloth. A
chest bound in iron stands at the foot of each pallet. The only way out
is the door west, back to the hallway.

13692.name: Sanctuary Of Orcus

north.description: To the north lies The Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Inner Sanctum.

13692.description:
Tall pillars carved as screaming horned faces hold up the sanctuary's
vaulted roof, and the air is heavy with bitter incense. A broad altar of
black basalt squats in the middle of the floor, its surface stained by
the offerings of many years. A door in the far wall leads south into the
inner sanctum, while the hallway lies back north. A red glow pulses from
iron bowls set high in the walls.

extra_descs.altar basalt:
The altar is a single block of black basalt, its top grooved with
channels that run to a stained basin at one corner. Old offerings have
left a dark crust in every groove.

13693.name: Inner Sanctum

north.description: To the north lies Sanctuary Of Orcus.

south.description: To the south lies Into The Void.

13693.description:
A small round chamber where the god's secret rites are kept, its walls
covered in spiral carvings that seem to turn when you look away. A
single black candle burns upon a stone stand and never gutters. The way
south stands open now, a dark archway through which a cold draught
breathes from some deeper place beyond the temple. The door north leads
back to the sanctuary.

13694.name: The Granite Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Cavern Of Sorrow.

down.description: To the down lies The Granite Stairs.

13694.description:
A stair cut into solid granite descends here in wide, shallow steps,
each worn into a hollow by centuries of feet. The air grows colder and
damper with every step down. Faint scratches mark the walls like tally
strokes. The stair climbs back up to the cavern and continues down into
blackness.

13695.name: The Granite Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Granite Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Granite Stairs.

13695.description:
The stair spirals gently as it falls, its inner wall a smooth curve of
pink granite veined with white. Water runs in a thin sheet down one
side, making each step treacherous. Far below, a low rumble of something
moving carries up the shaft. You can climb up to the steps above or go
down toward the deeper dark.

13696.name: The Granite Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Granite Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Granite Stairs.

13696.description:
Here the steps are cut so deep and steep that you must go down them with
a hand on the wall. Holes bored in the rock at intervals once held
torches, but only soot-stained hollows remain. The stone is cold as iron
and crusted with a pale mineral bloom. The stair goes up, and it goes
down.

13697.name: The Granite Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Granite Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Lair Of The Manticore.

13697.description:
The stair ends in a wide landing littered with splintered bones and
tufts of coarse tawny hair. Deep gouges mark the granite walls at the
height of a man's shoulder. A rank, feline stink rises from the chamber
below. Steps lead up to the stair above, and a ramp falls steeply down
into a lair.

13698.name: The Lair Of The Manticore

up.description: To the up lies The Granite Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Granite Stairs.

13698.description:
A broad, vaulted lair stinks of musk and old blood. Bones of men and
beasts lie heaped in a hollow of the floor, and long barbed quills
bristle from cracks in the wall where something rubbed past. Claw-marks
score the pillars from floor to ceiling. The stair climbs up to the
landing, and a ragged passage drops down to the next flight.

13699.name: The Granite Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Lair Of The Manticore.

down.description: To the down lies A Glowing Tunnel.

13699.description:
The last flight of the stair ends in a ragged archway, beyond which a
dim greenish glow lights a tunnel running down. The walls here are
fused, glassy and strangely warm to the touch. The steps climb back up
toward the lair above, and the opening leads down toward that eerie
light.

13700.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Crossing.

up.description: To the up lies Under The Dump.

13700.description:
A rough shaft opens in the ceiling here, and a draught of stale, rotten
air falls from it carrying the stink of refuse. Rungs of rusted iron are
hammered into the rock, leading up toward the heap of rubbish above. The
tunnel itself runs east into the gloom. The floor is littered with
fallen scraps and black, greasy puddles.

13701.name: Three Way Crossing

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13701.description:
A crossing where the tunnel splits three ways beneath a cracked roof.
Grit sifts down constantly. The floor is paved with flat stones in one
patch, as if someone once began to make a road and gave up. Passages
lead north, south and west.

13702.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Crossing.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13702.description:
The tunnel makes a sharp bend, from the north toward the west, in the
stone of a ridge of red rock. Streaks of rust bleed from the wall. A
heap of crumbled stone fills the elbow of the bend. The air is dry and
warm.

13703.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13703.description:
A tunnel of uniform width, with a floor trodden hollow along its middle.
Strange flat patches of lichen glow dimly on the roof. A broken pick
handle lies across the way. Footing is firm in that long passage, which
leads east and then away west into darkness.

13704.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Bend.

13704.description:
A drip falls from the roof in the exact centre of the tunnel, and has
worn a small bowl in the stone. Rows of small holes in the wall, evenly
spaced, show where timbers once braced it. The air carries the stale
smell of long-dead fires. The passage runs east and west.

13705.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

13705.description:
A bend where the tunnel climbs a little way from the east toward the
north. The roof drips steadily on a flat stone. Someone has stacked a
cairn of small pebbles by the wall as a marker. A rancid reek drifts
down from the passage ahead.

13706.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

13706.description:
The tunnel is rough and unfinished, its walls bristling with the stumps
of broken pick work. A rusty mattock head sits fixed in a crack. The air
is noticeably colder, and the rumble of distant drums travels through
the floor. A way lies north, and another south.

13707.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Crossing.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13707.description:
The tunnel here is a cramped throat of bare grey rock, scored by old
pick marks and blackened by torch smoke. Water seeps down one wall and
gathers in a shallow trough along the floor. The passage runs on north
to a crossing of ways, and back south into the dark the way you came. A
faint, steady thudding carries from somewhere far off, like a drum heard
through stone.

13708.name: Three Way Crossing

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13708.description:
Three tunnels once met at this crossing, but a rockfall has choked the
third mouth with grey rubble and splintered props. What remains is a
bend in the rock where the floor is trampled flat by hobnailed boots. A
stub of tallow candle burns in a niche, black with smoke. The way east
leads on along the tunnel, and the way south falls back toward a
narrower passage.

13710.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Crossing.

west.description: To the west lies Three Way Crossing.

13710.description:
A long straight stretch of tunnel, its roof so low that taller
travellers must stoop beneath the cross-timbers. Crude scratchings mark
the walls: tally lines, a bared tooth, a clenched fist. The floor is
gritty with ash and crushed bone. East the tunnel opens toward another
crossing, while west it runs back to the rockfall.

13711.name: Three Way Crossing

north.description: To the north lies In The Bend.

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Crossing.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13711.description:
Three ways branch from this crossing, each mouth stained by the greasy
smoke of a pitch torch jammed in an iron ring. A sour smell of wet fur
and old meat hangs in the air. The north branch bends away along a
curving passage, the east branch runs on into the warren, and the west
branch returns to a low straight tunnel. Scuffs and drag marks cross the
floor in every direction.

13712.name: In The Bend

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Crossing.

west.description: To the west lies In The Bend.

13712.description:
The tunnel swings sharply here, its outer wall polished smooth by
countless shoulders brushing past. Rust-coloured stains streak the rock
at head height. The crossing lies back to the south, and the passage
curls away west into shadow. Beyond the curve, a harsh chanting rises
and falls in a slow, marching rhythm.

13713.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies In The Bend.

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

13713.description:
Another bend, tighter than the last, forces the passage round a huge
shoulder of black rock. Pale fungus clings to the damp ceiling and drips
a cold, bitter water onto the stones. The way north climbs a gentle
slope into the dark, and east the passage returns toward the crossing. A
broken spear shaft is wedged in a crack in the wall, long since
forgotten.

13714.name: In The Bend

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

13714.description:
The walls close in at this bend until your pack scrapes the stone on
either side. Soot from a thousand torches has painted the ceiling a
velvet black, and the air tastes of char. Eastward the tunnel
straightens a little, while south it drops back to the tighter bend. A
scatter of gnawed bones lies pushed into the corner.

13715.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Bend.

13715.description:
The passage bends around a pillar of living rock that someone has hung
with rusted chains and a ring of yellow teeth. The floor is damp and
slick with black mud. North the way straightens into a longer tunnel,
and west it curves back along the bend. The air is warmer here, thick
with smoke from some hidden fire.

13716.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Bend.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

13716.description:
A straight, narrow tunnel runs through grey stone, its walls hacked into
ragged facets by crude picks. Every few paces a rusted bracket juts from
the rock, though only a few still hold a stub of torch. Northward the
passage reaches another bend, and south it returns to the pillar and its
chains.

13717.name: In The Bend

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Crossing.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13717.description:
The tunnel turns here at the edge of a wider cave, where the roof rises
out of reach of your light. Flowstone has crusted the walls in dirty
yellow folds, and a thin trickle runs down them into a crack in the
floor. East lies a crossing of tunnels, and south the way narrows back
toward the long passage. A far-off bellowing and the scrape of metal
echo through the rock.

13718.name: Three Way Crossing

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Bend.

13718.description:
A crossing of three tunnels beneath a roof of ribbed stone. Deep ruts in
the floor show where heavy carts turn at the meeting. A faded white
stripe is painted across the way west. A hanging lantern frame, long
empty, creaks in a draught. Passages lead east, south and west.

13719.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Crossing.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13719.description:
A straight, plain tunnel with walls hacked flat. A bundle of rotted
torches lies at the foot of the wall. The only variety is the pattern of
the tool marks, which sweep in slanting rows. The tunnel goes north and
south.

13720.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13720.description:
The tunnel here is wet and the floor is slippery with green slime. Water
gathers in a runnel down the middle, and the sound of it fills the
narrow space. A single bronze hook is set into the roof. The passage
leads north, and south as well.

13721.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Crossing.

13721.description:
Rough pillars of rock have been left standing at intervals, supporting
the roof where it looks weak. Scorch marks surround the base of each
pillar. A cold wind slips between them, humming. The tunnel goes north
and south to a crossing.

13722.name: Three Way Crossing

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Three Way Crossing.

13722.description:
Another meeting of tunnels, where the walls are scrawled with crude
pictures of tusked heads in charcoal. The roof is high and flat. A well-
trodden path leads west, and a narrower passage goes north and south.
Smoke stains the ceiling in a great dark fan.

13723.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Three Way Crossing.

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Crossing.

13723.description:
The tunnel narrows to a throat barely wide enough for a pair of
shoulders, then widens again. Chisel marks on the walls are fresh and
bright. A pile of stone chips lies against one wall, as if work stopped
only just now. Beyond the throat the passage goes north, or south.

13724.name: In The Bend

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Three Way Crossing.

up.description: To the up lies Dusty Tunnels.

13724.description:
The tunnel bends hard here, from the west round to the south, and a
rough ladder of notched logs climbs up through a hole in the roof. The
walls are blackened by fire and old smoke. A line of white paint on the
floor marks some boundary. A warm draught blows down from above.

13725.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Bend.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

13725.description:
A short straight passage between two bends, its walls ribbed with thin
stone seams. Water seeps along the floor in a shallow rill, gurgling
quietly. Bits of broken pottery lie in the rill. The passage runs on
both north and south between its two bends, and the damp is chill on the
skin.

13726.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies Hallway.

13726.description:
Here the passage turns from north to east, ending at a squared archway
where a hallway begins. The rock on the outer side of the turn is rubbed
smooth and dark. A rusty spike is driven into the wall at shoulder
height. Cold air flows from the hall.

13727.name: Hallway

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

south.description: To the south lies Hallway.

west.description: To the west lies In The Bend.

13727.description:
The hallway ends in a three-way meeting, where the squared stone gives
way to rough tunnel. A pair of broken pillars stand to each side of the
opening east, and the passage west sags into a bend. A scrap of faded
green cloth is nailed to the wall, a forgotten banner. The hall runs
south.

13728.name: Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Hallway.

13728.description:
Here the hallway's roof is lower and ribbed with arches of dressed
stone. Rings of tarnished brass are set in the walls at head height,
perhaps for torches or perhaps for chains. A draught hums softly along
it. The hall runs on north, and back south.

13729.name: Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Hallway.

13729.description:
Faded murals of marching figures cover the walls of the hallway here,
worn to ghosts by time and soot. Their hands are raised as though in
greeting or in surrender. A film of dust lies thick over the floor. The
hall continues north, and returns south.

extra_descs.murals figures:
The marching figures were once painted in bright pigment, but only their
outlines survive. At their head one figure wears a crown, and every
orcish hand has scratched out its face.

13730.name: Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Hallway.

13730.description:
The hallway continues, its floor tiled in cracked slabs of grey stone.
Faded paint on the ceiling still shows a pattern of red and blue stars.
A pile of rubble partly blocks one corner, leaving room to pass. The
hallway goes north and south.

13731.name: Hallway

north.description: To the north lies Hallway.

south.description: To the south lies Cavern.

13731.description:
A hallway cut square and true from the rock by some skilled hand, far
finer than the tunnels around it. The walls are smooth, though scored
with the claw marks of later visitors. Doorless alcoves stand empty at
intervals. It runs north and south, and a faint chill breathes along it.

13732.name: Cavern

north.description: To the north lies Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

13732.description:
A cavern of modest size, its roof a flat ceiling pitted with holes like
a sponge. Pale mushrooms grow in rings across the floor. The air feels
heavy and still. A tunnel goes east to a crossing, and a squared hallway
cut by tools runs north.

13733.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Three Way Crossing.

west.description: To the west lies Cavern.

13733.description:
A winding tunnel with a floor of damp sand runs east and west. On the
wall someone has painted a crude white skull with red ochre eyes, now
streaked by seepage. The sound of dripping grows louder toward the west,
where a cavern opens, while a crossing lies east.

13734.name: Three Way Crossing

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13734.description:
Three tunnels meet in a low cavern, where the roof is held up by two
pillars of natural rock. Soot-stained alcoves in the wall once held
watchmen. Crude marks scratched by a dozen hands show which way bands
went. Passages lead north, east and west.

13735.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies Three Way Crossing.

13735.description:
The tunnel slopes downward here, and the rock changes from grey to a
rust-red banded stone. Scrapes in the walls show where heavy loads were
dragged. A smell of damp iron fills the air. The tunnel runs north and
south.

13736.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Junction Of Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13736.description:
A long straight tunnel runs between a junction and a crossing, its floor
smooth with ages of foot traffic. The ceiling is crusted with soot, and
old torch brackets of rusty iron jut at intervals. Wet dark patches show
where groundwater seeps. The junction lies north and the way continues
south.

13737.name: Junction Of Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Peaceful Cavern.

13737.description:
Four tunnels meet in a ragged chamber, its roof held up by a single fat
pillar of natural stone. North the way climbs gently toward the sound of
water, south it falls into a long dark run, east it is cut narrow, and
west it opens upon a calm cavern. A cairn of skulls is heaped in the
pillar's shadow like a boundary mark.

extra_descs.cairn skulls:
A waist-high cairn of skulls, orc and man and beast together, stacked
with care around the foot of the pillar. A strip of black cloth is
knotted about the topmost one.

13738.name: Peaceful Cavern

east.description: To the east lies Junction Of Tunnels.

13738.description:
A small round cavern, strangely quiet, where the roar of the warren
fades to nothing. Clear water drips from a pale stalactite into a stone
basin, ringing like a tiny bell. The floor is soft with fine sand, and
the walls glitter with crystals. The only way out is a tunnel east.

13739.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Rocky Beach.

south.description: To the south lies Junction Of Tunnels.

13739.description:
The tunnel slopes gently and the air grows moist and cold, for a lake
lies close ahead to the north. The floor is wet pebble and silt, ribbed
by old high-water lines. Hooks of iron are hammered into the wall, from
which a net once hung. The way back south leads to a junction of
tunnels.

13740.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies Hole Room.

west.description: To the west lies Hallway.

13740.description:
