The passage bends here from the hallway on the west toward a chamber
north. The floor slopes and is littered with fist-sized stones fallen
from the roof. A square-cut lintel, much older than the tunnel, is set
above the entrance ahead. Dust stirs on a faint draught.

13741.name: Hole Room

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

up.description: To the up lies Dusty Tunnels.

13741.description:
A round chamber with a ragged hole in the roof through which a rope of
knotted hide hangs. The floor is a mess of rubble and dried droppings
fallen from above. Scratches on the walls mark the reach of those who
have climbed. The way out is south, and the hole leads up to dusty
tunnels.

13742.name: Rocky Beach

east.description: To the east lies Underground River.

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13742.description:
A narrow beach of black pebbles and broken rock lies along the edge of
an underground river that slides past in the dark. Slow water laps the
stones with a soft sucking sound, and mist hangs low over it. A rotting
boat is drawn up on the shingle, its planks sprung. The river flows away
east beyond reach of any light, and the tunnel lies back south.

13743.name: Underground River

east.description: To the east lies Underground River.

13743.description:
You drift on the black current of an underground river, hemmed by walls
that sweat and glisten overhead. Mist curls from the water, and the
pebbled beach slips away behind you. The current tugs gently onward to
the east. A cold wind travels along the water, smelling of far-off rock.

13744.name: Underground River

east.description: To the east lies Underground River.

13744.description:
The river narrows between sheer walls and runs faster, slapping at the
stone in hollow, echoing gulps. Spray flecks your face, and the roof is
so low that dripstones trail almost to the water. Your craft rocks and
spins before the current steadies and bears you east. A thin whistling
of wind comes from somewhere ahead.

13745.name: Underground River

east.description: To the east lies Cliffside.

13745.description:
The river widens into a dim hall of water, where tall columns rise out
of the dark and vanish overhead. Your craft turns slowly in a lazy eddy
before the current takes it east toward a cliff face. Pale fish with no
eyes flash beneath the surface. A smell of old rain and iron hangs on
the air.

13746.name: Cliffside

down.description: To the down lies Underground Lake.

13746.description:
A great wall of rock rises sheer from the water here, shining with
moisture and veined with quartz that catches your light. The river
tumbles over a lip in a short fall and the current draws you down toward
the open lake beneath. Foam gathers in a pale ring at the foot of the
cliff. The air roars with the water's fall.

13747.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Junction Of Tunnels.

13747.description:
The tunnel widens as it nears a junction ahead to the west, and its
floor is worn into a shallow groove by traffic. Bones of small beasts,
gnawed clean, lie heaped in a corner. The walls are dark, wet and
faintly warm to the touch. The sound of dripping echoes and doubles
back.

13748.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13748.description:
A cramped passage runs east and west, so low that its roof scrapes at
the shoulders. Chisel work has left the walls in flat facets, rough with
the grime of ages. A thin line of white salt crusts the base of the rock
where seepage dries. The smell of damp lingers.

13749.name: In The Bend

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies Rocky Shore.

13749.description:
The tunnel turns here, from the south round toward the west, and in its
floor a steep slope falls away to a rocky shore far below. Cold air
rises from that slope, tasting of mineral water and mould. Rough steps
have been hacked into the stone by some patient hand. The roof is hung
with pale dripstones.

13750.name: In The Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies In The Bend.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

13750.description:
A straight, narrow gut of tunnel runs north and south here between walls
that sweat with damp. Old torch smoke has blackened the ceiling in long
streaks, and a spent brand lies in a niche. The footing is treacherous
with loose gravel. Somewhere ahead, running water mutters in the dark.

13751.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies In The Bend.

13751.description:
A sharp elbow of the tunnel, where the passage swings in from the west
toward a longer run north. Orc claws have scored crude arrows and
slashes into the rock, marking some claim or warning. The floor is
churned to mud by countless iron-shod feet. A sour animal reek hangs in
the air.

13752.name: In The Bend

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend.

up.description: To the up lies The Small Tunnel.

13752.description:
The tunnel makes a hard bend here, one arm running east and the other
south, and the ceiling rises into a cleft where a hole to the upper
level opens. Grit crunches underfoot. The walls glisten with a skin of
seep-water that mirrors any light like black glass. A rope of braided
hide, long rotted, dangles from the climb.

13753.name: In The Bend

north.description: To the north lies In The Bend.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13753.description:
A bend in the passage where the tunnel turns from the west toward the
north. The rock overhead is cracked and a trickle of water falls in a
slender silver thread to splash on a flat stone. Bits of flint litter
the floor where someone sharpened blades. Warm air rolls down from the
passage ahead.

13754.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend.

west.description: To the west lies Underground River.

13754.description:
The tunnel runs close beside the river, whose dark water can be heard
rushing near at hand. Wet air blows in from the west where the river
flows, and the passage leads east to a bend. Pebbles and silt cover the
floor. The planks of an old boat lie against the wall, grey and furred
with mould.

13755.name: Rocky Shore

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

up.description: To the up lies In The Bend.

13755.description:
A beach of dark gravel and slick boulders lies at the foot of a long
slope that climbs steeply to the tunnel above. The lake laps the stones
east with cold small waves. Shells of freshwater snails crunch
underfoot. A rotted net hangs from the rock like a grey curtain.

13756.name: Underground Lake

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

13756.description:
The river pours out into a vast lake whose far shores are lost in
blackness, and the roof overhead is a distant mystery. Dark water heaves
in slow swells, and the roar of the fall is never quite lost, high above
you. You can steer east across the open lake or south along the rocky
margin. Cold breath rises from the depths.

13757.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Rocky Shore.

13757.description:
A rocky shore lies close to the west, a fan of grit and boulders where a
stair of rough steps climbs into the dark. Lake water leads north, east
and south. The surface here is oily and still, and the stink of wet
stone and fish is strong. A broken boat hook floats among the weed.

13758.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

13758.description:
The shore of the lake is close, a cliff of dripping flowstone rising
straight from the water. Streams of milky water pour down it into the
lake with a steady rushing. The surface is silvery with spray. Water
leads north along the cliff and east across the lake.

13759.name: Underground Lake

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

13759.description:
A shelf of shallows lies close beside you here, where pale weed waves
like hair in the current and the water turns the colour of tea. A wall
of dripping rock closes in on the near side. The deeper lake lies east
and south, black and quiet. Now and then a bubble rises and bursts with
a small wet sound.

13760.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13760.description:
You float at the crossing of the lake, where the black water spreads in
every direction and no shore shows anywhere. A broken stone pillar
stands out of the water close by, topped with a crust of old bat
droppings. Long slow swells roll under your craft from the west and run
on east, while open water also lies north and south. The air is cold and
tastes of copper.

13761.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13761.description:
Rafts of bleached bones and driftwood have collected here, bound by weed
into a floating mat that slides against your craft. The water beneath is
black as ink. Open water lies on every side, north, east, south and
west. A pale glow in the deep drifts slowly past and fades.

13762.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13762.description:
The water turns in a slow wide whirl, drawing your craft round in a lazy
circle. Loose weed and splinters spiral round with you. The lake lies
open north, east, south and west, and each way looks the same in the
dark.

13763.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

13763.description:
A low reef of jagged rock just breaks the surface here, each point wet
and black like a row of teeth. You keep clear of it by steering north or
east. A deep boom rolls across the water, the echo of drums carried from
a long way off.

13764.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13764.description:
The lake ends against a steep shelf of rock slick with green slime, and
the water here is shallow and thick with silt. Tiny blind fish dart away
beneath your craft. A rusted anchor lies on the shelf, long abandoned.
Open water lies north and west.

13765.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13765.description:
The lake is calm and wide here, and far overhead a patch of roof glows
with pale lichen, like a drift of dim stars. By their light the water
shows endless in all four directions, north, east, south and west. A
small white skull bobs past on the swell.

13766.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13766.description:
A light current runs through the water here, tugging your craft gently
from the west toward the east. Long ribbons of weed trail in it,
anchored somewhere in the depths. The lake offers a way on in every
direction, whether north, east, south or west. The surface is dotted
with the rings of rising fish.

13767.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13767.description:
The air is warmer here, and a thin film of steam lifts from the water as
if a hot spring fed the lake from below. Droplets gather on the roof far
above and fall in a fine rain. You may steer in any direction, north,
east, south or west. A sulphurous whiff comes and goes.

13768.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13768.description:
Drops fall steadily from the unseen roof, each one ringing out on the
water in a widening circle. The lake lies open all around, with water
leading north, east, south and west alike. Streaks of pale glowing
fungus float on the surface in loose rafts, throwing a sickly green
light on the swell.

13769.name: Underground Lake

east.description: To the east lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

13769.description:
The lake narrows toward a corner of the cavern where the roof comes down
close above the water in a mass of grey stalactites. A rotted raft of
lashed logs wallows half-sunk beside you, its ropes trailing in the
current. Open water lies east, and the lake spreads away south. The echo
of every splash comes back twice.

13770.name: Underground Lake

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13770.description:
You drift into the farthest corner of the lake, where the black water
laps against a sheer wall of dark stone. A long scar of rust-red mineral
runs down the wall, as if the rock itself had bled. There is no landing
here, only water south and water west. The air is still and thick, and
the silence presses on your ears.

13771.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13771.description:
Mist lies thick on the water, and your light dwindles to a smear a few
strides across. Water lies open north toward a corner of the lake and
south along its edge, and west toward the centre. On the other side the
rock rises sheer and slick with moss. Somewhere unseen a large thing
breaks the surface and sinks again.

13772.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13772.description:
A tall column of fused stone rises from the water here, wider than a
house, its sides ribbed like melted wax. You skirt it slowly, the swell
slapping against its base. Open water runs north and south along the
face of the rock, and west toward the middle of the lake. A rusted iron
ring, thick as an arm, is sunk into the column above the waterline.

13773.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Rocky Shore.

south.description: To the south lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13773.description:
A stony shore shows dimly to the east, a shelf of tumbled boulders where
the lake gives out its last strength in small waves. Lake water leads on
north, south and west into the dark. A line of old stakes, black with
age, leans out of the water as though a landing stage once stood here.
The wind carries a smell of smoke and sour meat from the land.

13774.name: Underground Lake

north.description: To the north lies Underground Lake.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13774.description:
The lake edge is close here, a wall of stone shelving into black water,
with a ledge strewn with slimy weed. The lake leads off north and then
west. Nothing stirs but the slow rise and fall of the swell, and a drip
somewhere keeps its patient count.

13775.name: Rocky Shore

east.description: To the east lies In The Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Underground Lake.

13775.description:
A rocky shore of tumbled boulders and coarse grit, where the cold waves
of the lake wash out against the stones. Scraps of rope and a broken oar
lie among the wrack. The lake lies west, black and endless, while a
tunnel mouth opens east, its walls scorched with old torch smoke. Rough
boot prints, long dried, cross the grit toward it.

13776.name: In The Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies The Old Orc Camp.

west.description: To the west lies Rocky Shore.

13776.description:
The tunnel runs east from the lakeshore toward a wider space, and its
floor has been trodden hard and flat. Soot streaks the ceiling above the
stump of a torch bracket, and bone splinters are ground into the grit. A
smell of ashes and tanned hide grows stronger as you go. The cold of the
lake fades behind you.

13777.name: Dusty Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Small Grotto.

east.description: To the east lies Dusty Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies In The Bend.

13777.description:
A fork in the tunnel where a hole in the floor opens to a bend below,
and a worn path runs on into a small grotto. Dust hangs in the air, and
a breath of damp warmth rises from the hole. Footprints gather round its
edge. The tunnel leads east, and the grotto lies north.

13778.name: Small Grotto

south.description: To the south lies Dusty Tunnels.

13778.description:
A tiny grotto, its walls glittering with crystals the size of fingers. A
shallow pool in the centre holds clear, cold water and a scatter of pale
pebbles. Soft drips fall from the stalactites and ring like little
bells. The only way out is back south into the dusty tunnels.

extra_descs.crystals pool:
The crystals are clear as glass and sharp as nails, clustered thick on
the walls. The pool is shallow, and its water tastes of cold iron.

13779.name: Dusty Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Dusty Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Dusty Tunnels.

13779.description:
A steep-sided tunnel, the roof low and rough, with crude steps cut down
in places. Fine pale dust coats everything. Strips of cloth are tied to
old iron spikes in the wall, perhaps as markers. The passage leads east
and west.

13780.name: Dusty Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Dusty Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies Dusty Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Dusty Tunnels.

13780.description:
A tunnel hewn square, with deep scrape marks in the floor where loaded
sledges once ran. The dust is dark with soot here and clings to the
walls in sooty webs. A rusted lantern lies on its side. The passage runs
north and south, and a side path leads west.

13781.name: Dusty Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Dusty Tunnels.

east.description: To the east lies Dusty Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Dusty Tunnels.

13781.description:
A junction in the dusty tunnels, where the floor has been swept by many
feet into dark bare patches. A stack of empty barrels, staves cracked,
stands in a corner. Old iron nails still stud the walls where lamps once
hung. Ways lead north, east and west.

13782.name: Dusty Tunnels

west.description: To the west lies Dusty Tunnels.

13782.description:
A dry, dusty tunnel where the dust lies so deep that every footstep
raises a pale cloud. The walls are cut square and smooth by ancient
hands, and the roof is held by arches of fitted stone. Webs of dust hang
in the corners like grey lace. The tunnel ends here, and the only way is
back west.

13783.name: Dusty Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Dusty Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies Dusty Tunnels.

13783.description:
A long dry passage where a draught blows steadily, carrying the dust in
veils along the floor. Cracks in the wall have been stuffed with rags,
long rotted to powder. Grey webs of dust hang from the roof. The tunnel
runs east and west.

13784.name: Dusty Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Dusty Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies Dusty Tunnels.

13784.description:
The dusty tunnel bends sharply, its roof so low that grey powder gathers
on the crown of your head. Footprints, shallow and indistinct, wander
through the dust and are lost. A dry rattle of falling grit comes from
somewhere. The bend turns east and south.

13785.name: Dusty Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Dusty Tunnels.

down.description: To the down lies Hole Room.

13785.description:
Dust lies deep and soft in this tunnel, as fine as flour, and rises in
clouds at each step. The hole in the floor drops down to the chamber
below. Along the walls, pale shelves of rock are furred in grey. The
tunnel runs north.

13786.name: Dusty Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies Dusty Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies Dusty Tunnels.

13786.description:
The dust thins and the floor shows bare stone worn smooth in a groove.
On one wall a faded painted arrow points ahead, and under it runs a
column of orcish tally strokes. A damp patch in the roof drips into a
glistening pool. The passage leads on north and winds back south.

13787.name: Dusty Tunnels

north.description: To the north lies A Prison Set In Stone.

east.description: To the east lies Dusty Tunnels.

south.description: To the south lies Dusty Tunnels.

13787.description:
A broader place in the tunnels, where the roof is held up by a pair of
fat timber props. A door of rusted iron is bolted with three heavy bars,
and it opens on a prison to the north. Another tunnel leads east, and
the way you came lies south. The floor is scored with the marks of
dragged feet.

13788.name: Dusty Tunnels

east.description: To the east lies Dead End.

west.description: To the west lies Dusty Tunnels.

13788.description:
The passage narrows and the roof comes down, so that you must bend
double. The dust here is churned by many feet, all going one way. A
trail of dark drips on the floor leads east. The way west returns to the
broader place.

13789.name: Dead End

west.description: To the west lies Dusty Tunnels.

13789.description:
The tunnel ends against a wall of broken rock. A heap of rotten sacking
lies in one corner, beside a puddle of old wax. Scratched in the stone
is an arrow pointing back the way you came, and a single word you cannot
read. The only way out is back west.

13790.name: A Prison Set In Stone

south.description: To the south lies Dusty Tunnels.

west.description: To the west lies The Inescapable Prison.

13790.description:
A prison cut straight out of the living rock: a low windowless cell with
a ring of iron in the floor, a chain and a trough for water. The walls
are scratched with the marks of those who waited here. The air is thick
with despair and old straw. The only way out is the door south.

13791.name: The Inescapable Prison

east.description: To the east lies A Prison Set In Stone.

13791.description:
Smooth walls of black stone close in on every side, seamless as polished
glass, with neither door nor window. A faint humming comes from the
stone itself, and the air is stale and still. The floor is scratched
with tally marks, rows upon rows, made by hands that gave up counting
long ago.

13800.name: The Old Orc Camp

east.description: To the east lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies In The Tunnels.

13800.description:
A wide cavern floor, long since given to an orc war-band: black rings of
old fires, trampled bedding of rotten straw, and a rack of splintered
spear shafts. The walls bear daubs of red ochre in the shape of crude
hands. A tunnel leads west toward the lake, and a stranger natural
passage opens east. Nothing here has been tended in a long while.

13801.name: A Natural Cave Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Old Orc Camp.

13801.description:
Here the work of axe and pick ends and a natural tunnel begins, winding
like the gut of some great beast. The walls are smooth, rippled and
cold, running with thin threads of water. The floor tilts south, where
the tunnel twists out of sight, and the old camp lies back west. A faint
sulphur tang hangs in the air.

13802.name: A Natural Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

13802.description:
The cave tunnel twists tightly, its walls pinching together and then
flaring out again to take a turn east. Stone flows in frozen sheets down
one side, cream and rust in colour like melted candles. Pools stand in
basins at the foot of the flowstone, each one rimmed with tiny crystal.
The passage lies back north.

13803.name: A Natural Cave Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

13803.description:
A narrow throat of natural stone where you must turn sideways in places
to pass. A curtain of delicate stone straws hangs in hundreds from the
ceiling and rings faintly if brushed. The way runs south into a wider
gallery and west toward the passage you came by. Wet clay holds the
prints of bare feet.

13804.name: A Natural Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

13804.description:
The tunnel opens into a gallery of round bulging chambers, like the
bubbles in cooled bread. The floor is worn and slippery, and falls
gently east, where a draught blows steadily. Back north the passage
narrows to the throat you came through. Clusters of white cave flowers
bloom in the rock, delicate as frost.

13805.name: A Natural Cave Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Atop The Twisting Stairs.

west.description: To the west lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

13805.description:
The cave tunnel straightens and runs level to a mouth in the stone where
a great flight of stairs begins to the east. The air moves strongly
here, rising from far below with a smell of hot stone and smoke, and a
low rumble of drums comes with it. Handprints in ochre mark the walls in
a long line. The way west returns toward the gallery.

13806.name: Atop The Twisting Stairs

west.description: To the west lies A Natural Cave Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies The Twisting Stairs.

13806.description:
You stand on a ledge of cut stone at the head of a stair that spirals
down into the dark, its steps worn to bowls by ancient feet. A rail of
rusted chain hangs along the outer edge, bolted into the rock. Warm air
climbs out of the stairwell, and the drums are louder here. The natural
tunnel lies back west.

13807.name: The Twisting Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Atop The Twisting Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Twisting Stairs.

13807.description:
The stair winds tightly round a central core of stone, each step a
hand's breadth wide at the narrow end and slick with grease and soot.
Torch niches pierce the outer wall, but only blackened stumps remain.
The echo of your tread comes back from above and below at once. The
steps climb up and descend down.

13808.name: The Twisting Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Twisting Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies The Twisting Stairs.

13808.description:
Halfway down the spiral a rough landing has been hewn from the wall,
where long ago some guard dozed on a stone bench. Crude tallies and a
drawing of a tusked face are scratched into the bench. The warm air is
thicker here, tinged with the sharp reek of hot metal. The stair goes on
both up and down.

13809.name: The Twisting Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The Twisting Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies At The Foot Of The Twisting Stairs.

13809.description:
The steps grow steeper and wetter as the spiral nears its end, and the
sound of drums comes up through the stone like a heartbeat. Black soot
coats the ceiling above the last torch niche. A smear of old blood has
dried on the central core where a body once scraped past. The stair
climbs back up and drops a short way more.

13810.name: At The Foot Of The Twisting Stairs

east.description: To the east lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The Oldest Road.

up.description: To the up lies The Twisting Stairs.

13810.description:
The spiral of stairs ends at a floor of smooth, much-trodden stone
beneath a low arch. A wide passage crosses here, with an old cave tunnel
leading east and the Oldest Road running away west. The air is hot and
dry compared to the stair, and the rumble of drums is clear. Above, the
stair winds up into darkness.

13813.name: An Old Cave Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies At The Foot Of The Twisting Stairs.

13813.description:
This old cave tunnel is rounded and smooth, its floor worn by ages of
feet into a shallow trough. Pale crusts of mineral cling to the ceiling
in clots. The air is dry and a little stale, like a long-shut cupboard.
The tunnel runs south, and back west lies the foot of the stairs.

13814.name: An Old Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

13814.description:
A dry and dusty bend in the old tunnel, where the walls are rubbed shiny
at shoulder height by passing bodies. Little pits dot the floor where
drops have fallen from the ceiling for ten thousand years. A shred of
rotted leather lies in a corner. The way leads north toward the stairs
and west deeper in.

13815.name: An Old Cave Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies A Dead End In The Old Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

13815.description:
Three ways meet here in a small chamber with a domed roof. A dead end
lies south, a tunnel runs on west, and the way you came lies east.
Someone once painted a white spiral on the wall, and it has flaked away
to a ghost. The stone is cool and the silence deep, broken only by the
faint tick of settling rock.

13816.name: A Dead End In The Old Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

13816.description:
The old tunnel ends here against a blank face of fallen rock, where the
roof has come down in a slope of rubble. Between the stones, a hand's
width of black gap breathes cold air. A small rounded niche in the wall
holds a heap of ancient bones, brittle and grey. The only way out is
back north.

13817.name: An Old Cave Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Oldest Road.

east.description: To the east lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

13817.description:
The cave tunnel rises to a low mouth opening north onto the Oldest Road,
and a trace of lighter air drifts in. The floor holds the ruts of
ancient cart wheels where the road once ran into the rock. Scraps of
flowstone cover the walls like candle drippings. The tunnel leads on
east into dry darkness.

13818.name: The Oldest Road

east.description: To the east lies At The Foot Of The Twisting Stairs.

south.description: To the south lies An Old Cave Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Oldest Road.

13818.description:
The Oldest Road runs here as a pavement of enormous slabs, cracked and
heaved but still plain. A great vault of rock arches overhead, so high
that the torchlight dies before it finds the roof. East the road ends at
an arch and the foot of a stair, a tunnel mouth opens south, and the
road runs on west. Stone posts stand along the verge, carved with worn
runes.

extra_descs.posts runes:
The stone posts are carved with runes so worn they can be felt more
easily than read. One bears the crude scratch of an orc tally over the
older writing.

13819.name: Along The Oldest Road

north.description: To the north lies Along The Oldest Road.

east.description: To the east lies The Oldest Road.

13819.description:
The old road bends along the foot of a cliff wall, its slabs split by
ribs of pale stone growing up between them. Drifted dust lies in smooth
banks. On the other hand a drop falls away into dark of unknown depth.
Milestones, if they ever stood, have toppled. The road goes north and
returns east.

13820.name: Along The Oldest Road

south.description: To the south lies Along The Oldest Road.

west.description: To the west lies Along The Oldest Road.

13820.description:
A stretch of road where the paving is whole and the slabs lie tight as
the day they were laid. Faint runes carved along the kerb tell of tolls
or oaths in a tongue no one reads. The vault above is stained by the
smoke of ancient lamps. The way runs on west, and returns south.

13821.name: Along The Oldest Road

north.description: To the north lies Along The Oldest Road.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Oldest Road.

13821.description:
Here a tumble of fallen rock has buried half the road, leaving a narrow
track around it. Among the stones lies the shaft of a toppled lamp post
of black iron. A warm wind blows steadily from the north, bearing the
sulphur of a distant fire. The road lies back east.

13822.name: Along The Oldest Road

south.description: To the south lies Along The Oldest Road.

west.description: To the west lies The Gateway To The Underworld.

13822.description:
The road widens as it nears a great gateway to the west, its stones
scorched and crazed with heat. Two broken pillars of black stone flank
the way. The air shimmers and smells of brimstone, and from somewhere
far off comes the beat of drums. The road returns south.

13823.name: The Broken Bridge

south.description: To the south lies The Gateway To The Underworld.

13823.description:
The road ends in a broken span of stone, which once crossed a chasm and
now stops short over a fall of unmeasured depth. Red light glows far
below, and heat rises in waves that make the air tremble. The broken
edge is crumbled and sharp. The only way back is south to the gateway.

13824.name: Along The Oldest Road

north.description: To the north lies The Gateway To The Underworld.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing The North Side Of The Cleft.

13824.description:
Beyond the gateway the road tilts and breaks, and a steep stair of
tumbled blocks goes down into a cleft. Heat pours from the cleft, along
with a low hissing like a thousand kettles. The paving here is blistered
and glazed. The way north leads back to the gateway.

13825.name: Climbing The North Side Of The Cleft

south.description: To the south lies South Of The Lava Stream.

up.description: To the up lies Along The Oldest Road.

13825.description:
A path of cracked ledges climbs along the near face of a deep cleft, the
rock hot to the touch. Far below, a river of lava crawls through the
cleft, sullen red under a skin of black crust. The ledges are slick with
sulphur crystals, yellow as butter. The path goes on south, and a climb
leads up to the road.

13827.name: South Of The Lava Stream

north.description: To the north lies Along The Oldest Road.

south.description: To the south lies The Mound Of Stones.

13827.description:
A shelf of scorched rock runs along the bank of the glowing stream that
creeps past. The heat is fierce enough to dry your lips and make the air
ripple. Glassy black crusts have formed on the stone, cracking and
ticking as they cool. The track goes north up the rock toward the road
and south toward a heap of stones.

13828.name: The Mound Of Stones

north.description: To the north lies South Of The Lava Stream.

east.description: To the east lies A Steam Filled Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies The Gate To Morkai.

west.description: To the west lies A Steam Filled Tunnel.

13828.description:
Travellers once piled stones here as tribute where four ways meet; now
the heap is crowned with orc skulls, all set facing south as a warning
to those who come up from the tunnels. Cold air flows from the tunnel
mouths east and west, carrying a smell of grave-dust. North the path
returns toward the cleft, and south it runs down to the black gate of
Morkai, where no drums have sounded for a long time.

extra_descs.mound stones heap skulls:
Most of the stones are scratched with orcish tallies, but the newest
bear a single mark, a ring with a dot at its centre like a staring eye.
An orc's broken war-horn has been laid at the very top.

13829.name: A Steam Filled Tunnel

west.description: To the west lies The Mound Of Stones.

13829.description:
Hot steam fills this tunnel so thickly that you can hardly see your
hand, rolling in slow white banks along the floor. Water beads on the
rock and runs in thin scalding threads. The stone is slick with a slimy
film, and the heat sticks your clothes to your skin. The only way out is
back west to the mound.

13830.name: A Steam Filled Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies The Mound Of Stones.

13830.description:
This steam tunnel is lower and narrower, and the vapour here carries a
taste of salt and rotten eggs. Yellow crystals fur the walls where hot
jets blow from cracks in the rock. Bubbles pop in a shallow, scalding
pool at the end of the passage. The way east leads out to the heap of
stones.

13831.name: The Gate To Morkai

north.description: To the north lies The Mound Of Stones.

south.description: To the south lies The City Of Morkai.

13831.description:
The great gate of Morkai stands open, its black iron leaves wrenched
outward as though something forced its way out rather than in. Orc
skulls still grin from the pikes along the battlements, and below them
the gate's last defenders stand propped in their armour, dead and
waiting. A chill breath flows from the city beyond. Few who pass south
from here come back; the mound of stones lies north.

13832.name: The City Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies The Gate To Morkai.

east.description: To the east lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies The Central Plaza Of Morkai.

west.description: To the west lies A Mound Of Carcasses.

13832.description:
Inside the gate, the dead city of Morkai opens out in a vast cavern lit
by tripods of cold green fire that give no warmth. Squat towers of black
stone lean over silent lanes that wind east, south and west, and
stalactites hang from the roof like teeth. Nothing here breathes, yet
armoured shapes move in the gloom between the houses. The broken gate
lies north.

13833.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

east.description: To the east lies Inside A Stone Building.

south.description: To the south lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

west.description: To the west lies The City Of Morkai.

13833.description:
A crooked street runs between low houses of stone and hide, their
doorways dark and their hearths long cold. Orc bones lie where they
fell, still gripping their cleavers, and some of them have begun to
stir. Black pennants hang limp from poles across the lane. A door stands
open east into a stone building, the street runs south, and the gate
road lies back west.

13834.name: Inside A Stone Building

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13834.description:
A bare stone room with a hearth of piled rocks, its ashes grey and cold
for many seasons. A family of orcs lies on the beaten earth floor, laid
out side by side as if for a burial nobody finished, and one empty space
waits among them. Weapon racks stand bare along the wall. The door west
opens back onto the street.

13835.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

east.description: To the east lies The Gate To The Church Of Light And Darkness.

south.description: To the south lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13835.description:
The street broadens at a crossing where a stone trough stands full of
black water skinned with ash. Bone-and-hide banners hang stiff from the
houses, and a pale mist creeps along the gutters. East a gate of black
iron bars leads into the grounds of a church, the street runs on south,
and it climbs back north toward the houses.

13836.name: At The Entrance To The Black Spire

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Black Spire.

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13836.description:
A square opens before the Black Spire, a tower of glassy dark stone that
rises until it merges with the cavern roof. Its iron door stands south,
and a sickly violet light pulses in the slits high above. War banners of
the dead tribes hang in tatters around the base, and skeletal sentries
stand among them, still until disturbed. Streets run north and west from
the square.

extra_descs.spire tower:
The spire is sheer and seamless, as if poured in one piece from molten
glass. It is cold as ice to the touch, and the face it shows back to you
is thin and grey, like the face of a corpse.

13837.name: Inside The Black Spire

north.description: To the north lies At The Entrance To The Black Spire.

up.description: To the up lies The Second Floor Of The Black Spire.

13837.description:
The ground floor of the spire is a round hall of dark glassy stone
ringed with arrow slits. Skeletal orc archers still stand at the slits
with their bows drawn on nothing, and their skulls turn slowly as you
pass. A spiral stair of iron winds up the wall, and a great brazier
burns with a cold violet flame. The door north returns to the square.

13838.name: The Second Floor Of The Black Spire

up.description: To the up lies Atop The Black Spire.

down.description: To the down lies Inside The Black Spire.

13838.description:
A round chamber once furnished for a war-leader, its long table still
spread with maps scratched on hide and pinned with daggers. Every map
has been redrawn in a dark and careful hand, marking roads up out of the
deeps toward the lands above. Narrow slits look down on the ghost-lit
city. The stair climbs up to the spire's top and winds down to the hall.

13839.name: Atop The Black Spire

down.description: To the down lies The Second Floor Of The Black Spire.

13839.description:
The roof of the spire is a flat platform ringed by a parapet of fanged
merlons, close beneath the cavern roof. Below, Morkai spreads out in a
silent jumble of green fires and black towers, and nothing in it moves
that is alive. A great bronze drum stands on its frame with its skin
split open. The only way off is the stair down.

13840.name: Before The Throne Room

north.description: To the north lies The Hall Of Corpses.

south.description: To the south lies The High Seat Of Morkai.

13840.description:
A vestibule of black granite, floored with a rug of grey wolf pelts gone
stiff and bald with age. Two iron braziers flank an arch framed with the
horns of some huge beast, and both burn with a dead blue flame. The
helms of orc chieftains hang in the arch as tributes, a skull still
inside each one. The throne room lies south, and the hall of the dead
north.

13841.name: The High Seat Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies Before The Throne Room.

13841.description:
A vast chamber at the heart of the city's power, hung with captured
banners that stir in no wind. On a dais of seven steps stands the high
seat, a throne of bones and black iron spiked with tusks, and on it sits
the city's king, dead and crowned and terribly awake. Rows of past
rulers' skulls watch from the walls. The only way out is the vestibule
north.

extra_descs.throne seat bones:
The throne is built of orc thighbones lashed with black iron and spiked
with tusks. Its arms are worn smooth by a ruler's hands, and the seat is
cold as a grave.

13842.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

east.description: To the east lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13842.description:
A dead-end alley of leaning shacks, closed at the far end by a blank
wall hung with skins that never finished drying. Rust-coloured water
stands between the stones, and something pale and many-legged has left a
glistening trail through it. A broken cart lies on its side, its driver
still slumped across the shafts. The only way out is east.

13843.name: The Central Plaza Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies The City Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13843.description:
The central plaza is a wide square ringed by the tallest houses of the
city, every door gaping open. In its middle stands a huge cracked statue
of an orc in plate armour, and around its base the dead of the last
battle lie in heaps, some of them slowly rising. Fire pits at each
corner burn with green flame. The wide street leads north to the gate
and south into the city.

extra_descs.statue orc armour:
The statue shows a great orc chieftain with a shattered sword arm. Fresh
scratches cover its plinth, as though many bony hands have tried to
climb it.

13844.name: The Well Of Souls

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

east.description: To the east lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

west.description: To the west lies The Hall Of Corpses.

13844.description:
A great round well, walled with white bones mortared in lime, stands at
the heart of a small plaza. A pale grey light breathes up out of it, and
with the light come whispers in orcish and in older tongues. Here the
dying of Morkai began. Lanes lead north and east, and a gaping arch west
opens on a hall emptied of its dead.

extra_descs.well bones wall:
The well wall is built of long bones laid in rings. Far down, the grey
light moves like a slow tide, and now and then it shows a face pressed
up against the dark.

13845.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies The Well Of Souls.

13845.description:
A narrow street winds between the blank walls of storehouses, their
doors barred with iron from the inside. Something has gouged long claw
marks down the bars, and a dried slime glitters on the stones beneath
them. A channel down the middle runs with thin grey water toward the
well. The street goes north and south.

13846.name: A Mound Of Carcasses

east.description: To the east lies The City Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13846.description:
A hill of the dead is heaped here, beasts and orcs together, hides and
horns and armour tangled in one great rotting mound. It is never still:
limbs shift, jaws work, and now and then a ghoul crawls out of the pile
to feed. A foul green ooze seeps from its base. The heart of the city
lies east, and a lane runs south.

extra_descs.mound carcasses hides dead:
Orc and beast lie tangled in the heap, layer on layer. Many of the bones
have been cracked and sucked clean, and the gnawing marks are far too
small and far too many.

13847.name: The Hall Of Corpses

east.description: To the east lies The Well Of Souls.

south.description: To the south lies Before The Throne Room.

13847.description:
A long hall whose walls are lined with niches, each made for a withered
orc bound in rags. Most niches are empty now: the dead have climbed
down, and their wrappings trail across the floor toward the doors. Hooks
hang from the beams where newer bodies once hung. The arch east opens to
the well, and a heavy door south leads on toward the throne.

13848.name: The Gateway To The Underworld

north.description: To the north lies The Broken Bridge.

east.description: To the east lies Along The Oldest Road.

south.description: To the south lies Along The Oldest Road.

13848.description:
A towering gate of fused black stone stands here, its great doors fallen
and lying in slabs. From the dark beyond comes a cold, wet wind and a
sound of many soft things moving, and a slime trail as wide as a cart
runs out between the posts. A road of old stone runs north to a ruined
bridge, south toward a descent, and east back along the way you came.

extra_descs.gateposts faces figures:
The gateposts are carved with writhing figures, their mouths wide. Among
the old carvings, newer marks have been scored deep into the stone:
rings of eyes, and long curling shapes like tentacles.

13884.name: The Gate To The Church Of Light And Darkness

east.description: To the east lies The Ante Chamber To The Church Of Light And Darkness.

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13884.description:
A gatehouse of black and white stone, built in stripes, spans the way to
the church. Of the two iron lamps in its arch, the bright one has gone
out, and the dark one burns on with a smoky violet flame. The prayers
painted along the wall have been scraped away and written over in a
crabbed, unreadable script. The street lies back west, and a heavy door
east leads on into the ante chamber.

13885.name: The Ante Chamber To The Church Of Light And Darkness

east.description: To the east lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

west.description: To the west lies The Gate To The Church Of Light And Darkness.

13885.description:
A narrow ante chamber where worshippers once laid down their weapons.
The racks along the wall are full again, but with bones: arms and legs
stacked as neatly as firewood. Benches of black wood line both sides,
and the floor is laid in tiles of white marble and black slate. The
church proper opens east, and the gate door is west.

13886.name: The Church Of Light And Darkness

north.description: To the north lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

east.description: To the east lies The Altar Stone Of Some Dark God.

south.description: To the south lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

west.description: To the west lies The Ante Chamber To The Church Of Light And Darkness.

13886.description:
The great nave of the church is paved in checkers of pale and sombre
stone, and pillars of white marble and black basalt rise to a vault lost
in shadow. The pews are filled with the dead, sitting upright in rows as
if waiting for a sermon. Side aisles curve away north and south behind
the pillars, the altar stone stands east, and the ante chamber door is
west.

13887.name: The Church Of Light And Darkness

east.description: To the east lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

south.description: To the south lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

13887.description:
This aisle of the church is a gloomy alley between pillars and wall,
where candle stubs burn with a cold blue light that never shortens. Pale
carvings of a radiant figure line the wall, every face hacked away and
replaced with a single carved eye. The aisle bends east toward the altar
end, and back south toward the nave.

13888.name: The Church Of Light And Darkness

north.description: To the north lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

east.description: To the east lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

13888.description:
A side aisle of the church, where tall windows have been bricked up,
leaving only their pointed outlines. Stone saints stand on plinths along
the wall, all of them beheaded, and the heads lie piled in a corner with
their eyes gouged out. Something wet has dragged itself across the dust
here more than once. The aisle goes north to the nave and east round the
altar.

13889.name: The Altar Stone Of Some Dark God

north.description: To the north lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

east.description: To the east lies The Inner Sanctum.

south.description: To the south lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

west.description: To the west lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

13889.description:
A great stone block, scorched and stained, stands on a stepped dais at
the head of the church. Its channels run with a black, oily fluid that
wells up out of the stone itself, and the dais is ringed with kneeling
skeletons in priests' robes, brows pressed to the floor. Aisles curve
north and south round the dais, a door leads east to an inner sanctum,
and the nave runs west.

extra_descs.altar stone block:
The altar is a single slab of dark stone, hollowed in the middle. The
black fluid in its hollow is cold, and it creeps very slightly toward
the warmth of your hand.

13890.name: The Church Of Light And Darkness

south.description: To the south lies The Altar Stone Of Some Dark God.

west.description: To the west lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

13890.description:
The aisle ends in a small chapel recess, where a stone basin holds black
water that never moves. Painted on the wall behind it is a faded sun,
and over the sun someone has painted a great dark eye, fresh and
glistening. The altar stone lies south, and the aisle runs back west. A
single lamp burns violet in the gloom.

13891.name: The Church Of Light And Darkness

north.description: To the north lies The Altar Stone Of Some Dark God.

west.description: To the west lies The Church Of Light And Darkness.

13891.description:
Rows of broken pews lie smashed against the wall in this corner of the
church, their carved ends gnawed. A cold draught breathes up through
cracks in the floor, carrying a smell of deep earth and rot, and every
crack is edged with a pale, rubbery growth that twitches at a touch. The
altar lies north and the aisle goes west.

13892.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies A Mound Of Carcasses.

south.description: To the south lies The Morgue.

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13892.description:
A bleak street hung with butchers' hooks runs between two blank walls.
The hooks are still loaded, but what hangs from them now are orcs, and
their heads turn to follow you. The paving is black with old blood. The
street leads north to the heap of the dead, south to a low building, and
back west.

13893.name: The Morgue

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13893.description:
A low vaulted room where the city's dead were laid out on slabs of
stone, row after row, each with a drain cut beneath it. Every slab is
empty. The straps that held the bodies down have been snapped from the
inside, and a butcher's saw lies where it was dropped. The cold here is
sharper than in the streets. The only way out is north.

13894.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

east.description: To the east lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13894.description:
The street turns a corner by a smithy whose chimney has long gone cold.
Inside, the hammering still rings, slow and steady, from a smith who has
been dead a long time. The cobbles are black with coal dust and scored
by iron-shod feet that never tire. The road leads east and back south.

13895.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

east.description: To the east lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

west.description: To the west lies The Well Of Souls.

13895.description:
The street slopes down toward a pit in the west, from which a cold air
breathes. Skulls are set into the wall plaster on each side, hundreds of
them, jaws agape, and as you pass they click their teeth together in a
dry, rippling chatter. Braziers burn low and green. The street runs back
east toward the spire.

13896.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

east.description: To the east lies At The Entrance To The Black Spire.

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13896.description:
A wide street where carts once wore deep ruts into the stone. The market
stalls along the verges are laid out with bones sorted by size, as if
the dead still keep their trade. The black bulk of the spire's base
shows east, and the street goes on north and west. A cold mist hangs
under the rotted awnings.

13897.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies The Central Plaza Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

west.description: To the west lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

13897.description:
A corner where three lanes join, with an iron gibbet standing at the
crossing. Its cage creaks in the draught, and the skeleton inside grips
the bars and watches you. A heap of broken crates is piled against a
house wall. The plaza lies north, the street runs on south, and a short
alley goes west.

13898.name: In The Streets Of Morkai

north.description: To the north lies In The Streets Of Morkai.

south.description: To the south lies At The Entrance To The Black Spire.

13898.description:
The street runs straight and downhill toward the black shaft of the
spire rising out of the gloom ahead. Strings of dried ears still hang
across the lane, and from behind a tavern wall comes a sound like
singing, flat and tuneless and never pausing for breath. The street lies
back north toward the crossing, and runs on south to a square.

13899.name: The Inner Sanctum

west.description: To the west lies The Altar Stone Of Some Dark God.

13899.description:
A bare windowless chamber, small as a cell, where the church kept its
secrets. Carvings of eyes cover the walls from floor to ceiling, and
here and there a real eye, wet and lidless, has opened in the stone
among them. A silver bowl blackened by fire sits in a niche. The air is
dead, and your breath is the only sound. The door west leads back to the
altar.

13928.name: Near The Prime Material Plane

south.description: To the south lies In The Tunnels.

13928.description:
A hazy, shimmering space where the stone seems thin as a veil, and
beyond it a pale, wavering light hints at another world. Cold motes
drift through the air and settle on your sleeves without melting. The
floor is cracked glass, and the silence is complete. South a rough
passage leads back down toward the tunnels.

651200.name: orc grunt warrior skull clan
651200.long_desc: A hulking Skull Clan orc in studded leather stands here, a notched cleaver in its fist.
651200.description:
The orc is broad as a door, with grey-green skin, tusks filed to points
and a skull daubed in white across its chest. Its small yellow eyes
follow you without blinking.

651201.name: warg wolf tunnel
651201.long_desc: A scarred tunnel warg prowls here, hackles raised and lips drawn back from yellow fangs.
651201.description:
The warg is a wolf bred huge and vicious in the dark, its black fur
matted and its flanks ridged with old whip scars. Slaver hangs from its
jaws in ropes.

651202.name: spider cave giant pale
651202.long_desc: A pale giant cave spider crouches here on a web of grey threads, its legs twitching.
651202.description:
The spider is the size of a calf, its body bloated and white as tallow
and its eight eyes like beads of black glass. Its fangs drip a clear
venom that smokes where it falls.

651203.name: orc shaman priest bone
651203.long_desc: A bone-hung orc shaman mutters here over a smoking bowl of ash.
651203.description:
The shaman is a stooped, wiry orc draped in bird skulls and rattling
finger-bones, its face painted with a red eye. It chants in a cracked,
droning voice and gestures with a staff tipped in a human skull.

651204.name: troll ice frost hulking
651204.long_desc: A hulking ice troll lumbers here, rime crusting its warty shoulders.
651204.description:
The troll is a mountain of blue-grey muscle, its hide encrusted with
frost and its breath a cloud of white. Its long arms drag knuckles of
ice on the floor.

651205.name: orc berserker raging
651205.long_desc: A raging orc berserker stamps here, foam at its tusks and a double-bladed axe in its hands.
651205.description:
The berserker is scarred from brow to belt, its eyes rolled red and its
skin streaked with the dried blood of old fights. It chews the edge of
its shield and howls without stopping.

651206.name: bolg ironjaw warden orc guard gate
651206.short_desc: Bolg Ironjaw, warden of the Black Gate
651206.long_desc: Bolg Ironjaw, warden of the Black Gate, stands before the iron bars, a spiked mace across his shoulders.
651206.description:
Bolg is an old orc captain with a jaw capped in black iron and a coat of
overlapping plates. A ring of heavy keys hangs from his belt, and he has
not left this gate in thirty winters.

651207.name: ugdush skullsplitter orc war-chief warchief
651207.short_desc: Ugdush Skullsplitter, war-chief of the Skull Clan
651207.long_desc: Ugdush Skullsplitter, war-chief of the Skull Clan, lounges on his throne of skulls with a great axe across his knees.
651207.description:
Ugdush is the largest orc you have ever seen, his body slabbed with
muscle and his tusks bound in bronze. A crown of spiked iron rests on
his brow, and the axe he carries has a notch for every chieftain he
killed.

651208.name: orc warrior tusked
651208.long_desc: A tusked orc warrior stands here, hefting a notched cleaver and glaring about.
651208.description:
A broad grey-green brute in scavenged plates, his lower tusks capped
with iron. He smells of smoke and sour fat, and his small eyes follow
every movement.

651209.name: cave wolf grey
651209.long_desc: A gaunt cave wolf prowls here, its ribs showing under a coat of dirty grey.
651209.description:
A rangy wolf bred in the warrens, pale-eyed and scarred, with a wet red
mouth. It circles on silent paws and bares fangs as long as a finger.

651210.name: pale cave spider
651210.long_desc: A pale cave spider the size of a dog clings to the rock, its fangs dripping.
651210.description:
A bloated, bone-white spider with pale unseeing eyes and long jointed
legs that tap the stone as it feels for you. Its fangs glisten with
venom.

651211.name: blind lake eel
651211.long_desc: A blind lake eel as thick as a man's thigh coils through the water here.
651211.description:
A pallid, eyeless eel as long as a boat, its jaw ringed with needle
teeth. It senses the ripples of your craft and glides closer.

651212.name: skeleton skeletal orc warrior
651212.long_desc: A skeletal orc warrior shambles through the street, a rusted cleaver dragging behind it.
651212.description:
The bones of a big orc, still wearing scraps of hide and a dented iron
cap. Green fire burns in its empty sockets, and it fights with the same
brute fury it had in life.

651214.name: ghoul rotting orc
651214.long_desc: A rotting orc ghoul crouches over a corpse, tearing at it with black nails.
651214.description:
A bloated, grey-green orc corpse with a jaw that unhinges to the chest.
Its claws drip a paralysing filth, and it moves in sudden, scuttling
bursts.

651224.name: skeleton skeletal orc archer
651224.long_desc: A skeletal orc archer stands at an arrow slit, bow drawn, its skull turning toward you.
651224.description:
An orc skeleton in a cracked leather jerkin, a black longbow of horn in
its fleshless hands. Its arrows are fletched with what look like human
fingernails.

651213.name: death knight morkai armoured
651213.long_desc: A death knight of Morkai keeps its silent watch in black plate, a cold blue light burning behind its visor.
651213.description:
Once the war-chief's sworn blackguard, now a hollow suit of black iron
moved by something that remembers only its oath. Where it walks, frost
creeps across the stones.

651225.name: shaman bone orc lich
651225.long_desc: An orc bone-shaman chants over a heap of bones, which twitch in answer.
651225.description:
A withered orc corpse in a robe sewn with finger bones, its jaw bound
shut with wire so that it chants through its teeth. A staff of stacked
vertebrae crackles with grave-cold light.

651226.name: wraith soul spirit
651226.long_desc: A soul wraith drifts up out of the stones, its face a smear of grey light.
651226.description:
One of the many souls the Well drew up from below, stretched thin and
starving. Its touch drains warmth and will, and it whispers names it no
longer owns.

651227.name: eye tyrant beholder
651227.long_desc: An eye tyrant floats in the gloom, its great eye fixed on you and its stalks writhing.
651227.description:
A floating orb of grey, scarred hide as wide as a cart, split by a mouth
of needle teeth. A single huge eye stares from its face, and a crown of
smaller eyes on stalks looks every way at once.

651228.name: mind flayer illithid
651228.long_desc: A mind flayer glides through the shadows, its face a nest of writhing tentacles.
651228.description:
A tall, robed figure with mauve, glistening skin and a head like an
octopus, four feelers twisting where its mouth should be. It does not
speak, but you hear it all the same.

651229.name: horror tentacled aberration
651229.long_desc: A tentacled horror heaves itself across the stones, leaving a trail of glistening slime.
651229.description:
A sagging mass of pale flesh and too many eyes, borne along on a mat of
grasping tentacles. It came up out of the dark below the city and has
not stopped feeding since.

651215.name: vrakk hollow-eyed death knight lieutenant
651215.long_desc: Vrakk the Hollow-Eyed, a death knight in red-stained plate, keeps watch from the top of the spire.
651215.description:
Gorbash's lieutenant in life, Vrakk is now a towering death knight whose
helm holds only darkness and two pinpricks of red. He still beats the
great drum at times, though no living war-band answers it.

651216.name: gorbash bone king lich orc
651216.long_desc: Gorbash the Bone King sits on the high seat, a lich crowned in black iron, his maul across his knees.
651216.description:
Once the war-chief who ruled Morkai by fear, Gorbash drank from the Well
of Souls to outlive his enemies and became something worse. His flesh
has fallen away, his crown has fused to his skull, and every dead thing
in the city answers his will.

651217.name: orschnag orc king
651217.long_desc: Orschnag the orc king stands in his hall, scarred and enormous, one hand on the haft of a great black axe.
651217.description:
Orschnag towers over the greatest of his warriors, a slab of grey muscle
hung with chains and the teeth of fallen foes. One tusk is capped in
iron, and his small red eyes miss nothing. He rules the tunnels by
terror and by the strength of his arm.

651218.name: gruzgash orc captain guard
651218.short_desc: Gruzgash, captain of the orc guard
651218.long_desc: Gruzgash, captain of the orc guard, glares from behind the table with a heavy cleaver at his belt.
651218.description:
Gruzgash is a squat, bull-necked orc whose left ear has been hacked
away. He wears a dented breastplate over a coat of rings and carries
himself like one who has never lost a fight he cared about. His guards
fear him more than any prisoner does.

651219.name: manticore beast
651219.long_desc: A hulking manticore crouches among the bones, its barbed tail lashing behind it.
651219.description:
The manticore has the body of a great tawny lion, the face of a snarling
old man, and a tail bristling with long black quills. Blood stains its
jaws, and its small eyes follow every move you make.

651220.name: spider great weaver
651220.long_desc: The great weaver spider hangs in its web, legs as long as spears twitching with hunger.
651220.description:
A spider the size of a wagon, its bloated body mottled grey and white,
hangs from cables of silk as thick as your wrist. Eight cold eyes gleam
in the dark, and its fangs drip a clear venom that hisses where it
falls.

651221.name: orc warrior tunnel
651221.long_desc: A tunnel orc warrior in studded leather scowls at you, a notched blade in hand.
651221.description:
The orc is broad and long-armed, with grey-green skin, lank black hair
and a jaw jutting with yellow tusks. Old scars crisscross his arms, and
his armour is patched with scraps of looted mail.

651222.name: wolf cave grey
651222.long_desc: A gaunt cave wolf prowls the tunnel, its pale eyes shining in the dark.
651222.description:
Years in the dark have bleached this wolf's coat to the colour of ash
and filled its eyes with a milky glow. It is lean to the bone and savage
with hunger, and it smells of damp stone and old blood.

651223.name: orc townsman citizen
651223.long_desc: An orc townsman in a stained apron shuffles past, muttering to himself.
651223.description:
A stooped, thick-wristed orc of Burzuk, he carries a sack over one
shoulder and keeps his eyes lowered to avoid trouble. His clothes are
patched and smoky, and he wants nothing more than to be left alone.

751200.name: jerkin hide studded orc
751200.room_desc: A studded orc-hide jerkin lies here, stiff with old grease.
751200.description: Thick hide, boiled and studded with iron nails in neat rows. It smells of smoke and sweat but turns a blade well.

751201.name: staff bone skull shaman
751201.room_desc: A skull-tipped bone staff lies here.
751201.description: A long staff of polished thigh-bone, topped with a skull whose eye-sockets are stuffed with red wax. Tiny charms rattle along its length.

751202.name: necklace fangs fang
751202.room_desc: A necklace of yellowed fangs lies here.
751202.description: A string of curved fangs, each as long as a finger, knotted together on a cord of gut. It clatters softly as you move.

751203.name: gauntlets iron warden black
751203.short_desc: a pair of black iron gauntlets
751203.room_desc: A pair of black iron gauntlets lies here.
751203.description: Heavy gauntlets of black iron, the knuckles drawn out into short spikes. Each bears a small stamped skull on the back.

751204.name: axe skullsplitter great notched
751204.room_desc: A great notched axe lies here, its edge dark with old blood.
751204.description: A two-handed axe with a broad crescent blade and a haft of black iron wood. Its edge is nicked in a long row, a tally of the heads it has cleaved.

751205.name: orc cleaver notched heavy
751205.room_desc: A heavy orc cleaver lies here, its edge notched with use.
751205.description: A broad, single-edged blade forged for hacking more than fencing. The tang is bound with strips of wolfhide.

751206.name: blackiron helm spiked orc
751206.room_desc: A spiked blackiron helm sits here, dented and scarred.
751206.description: A heavy helm of dull black iron with a ridge of spikes along the crown. Inside, someone has scratched a tally of kills.

751207.name: wolfpelt cloak grey pelt
751207.room_desc: A grey wolfpelt cloak lies here in a heap.
751207.description: A thick cloak sewn from the pelts of cave wolves, coarse and heavy but warm against the damp of the deeps.

751208.name: lieutenant gorget red iron
751208.room_desc: A red-stained iron gorget lies here, glinting dully.
751208.description: A gorget of riveted iron plates, its edges burnished by long wear. A red stain, never quite scrubbed away, marks the inside of the collar.

751209.name: skullcleaver maul skull
751209.room_desc: A great skull-faced maul rests here, heavy as an anvil.
751209.description: A mighty maul with a head of black iron cast in the likeness of a snarling skull. The haft is bound in the hide of a troll.

751215.name: cleaver bone hafted black
751215.room_desc: A black cleaver with a haft of fused bone lies here.
751215.description: A broad orc cleaver of black iron, its wooden haft long since replaced with a column of fused vertebrae. It is cold in the hand and never quite dull.

751216.name: shroud grave wrappings grey
751216.room_desc: A grey shroud of grave-wrappings lies here in a heap.
751216.description: Long strips of burial linen wound into a hooded cloak, stiff with grave-dust. The dead pay little heed to one who wears it.

751217.name: greathelm helm death knight black
751217.room_desc: A black iron greathelm, rimed with frost, lies here.
751217.description: A closed helm of black iron, its visor a narrow slit. Frost forms on it even here, and a faint blue glow lingers inside long after it leaves a dead head.

751218.name: amulet soul glass grey
751218.room_desc: A pendant of cloudy grey glass lies here, glowing faintly.
751218.description: A tear of grey glass on a chain of bone beads. Something small and pale moves inside it, and it murmurs when held to the ear.

751219.name: ring void iron black
751219.room_desc: A ring of lightless black metal lies here.
751219.description: A heavy band of metal so black it seems a hole in the air. It was cut from the stuff of the deep places, and the eye slides off it.

751220.name: blackplate plate armour red stained
751220.room_desc: A suit of black plate stained with old red lies here.
751220.description: The death knight's own armour, black iron plates riveted over a hauberk of mail and streaked with stains that never wash out. It is heavy and cold, and it does not dent.

751221.name: crown bone king black iron
751221.short_desc: the crown of the Bone King
751221.room_desc: A crown of black iron and bone lies here.
751221.description: A heavy circlet of black iron set with orc teeth and a single grey soul-glass stone. It was fused to a dead king's skull; worn by the living, it hums with cold strength.

751210.name: crown iron orschnag tusks
751210.room_desc: A heavy iron crown set with yellowed tusks lies here.
751210.description: A crown of black iron, dented by blows and set about with the tusks of a dozen slain chieftains. It sits heavy on the head and cold against the skull.

751211.name: cleaver heavy captain
751211.room_desc: A heavy, chipped cleaver lies here.
751211.description: A broad, single-edged blade, more butcher's tool than sword, with a grip bound in greasy leather. Its edge is nicked from a hundred hard blows.

751212.name: hauberk studded leather orc
751212.room_desc: A studded leather hauberk lies here, stiff with old sweat.
751212.description: A hauberk of thick leather sewn with iron studs and patched with scraps of mail. It reeks of smoke, but it turns a blade well enough.

751213.name: cloak tawny hide
751213.room_desc: A cloak of tawny hide lies here in a heap.
751213.description: A roughly cured cloak of coarse hide, thick as a rug and surprisingly warm. Long hairs of tawny gold are still caught in its seams.

751214.name: gloves silk weaver
751214.short_desc: a pair of weaver silk gloves
751214.room_desc: A pair of grey silk gloves lies here, tacky to the touch.
751214.description: Gloves woven from the strong grey silk of the deep spider, light as air yet strong as cord. They cling to the fingers like a second skin.
